title: Services Engagement Expert-Success Plan Manager-Delhi/Mumbai
description:

title: Customer Experience Manager
description:
At Kapture CX, we are looking for a
 **Customer Experience Manager** 
 in our Customer experience team.
   

  

 Kapture CX is an AI\-native, verticalized SaaS platform helping enterprises automate and execute complex customer and business workflows.
   

  

 At the core of Kapture is AgentOS — our Agentic Operating System that brings together AI agents, human intelligence, enterprise systems, and operational intelligence to execute work end\-to\-end. AgentOS enables enterprises to build, deploy, orchestrate, monitor, evaluate, and optimize AI\-powered workflows across customer support, sales, collections, claims, and other business operations.
   

  

 Today, Kapture is trusted by 1,000\+ enterprises across 18 countries, helping organizations move beyond isolated automation toward intelligent, outcome\-driven operations.
   

  

**What is this role all about?**
 As a
 **Customer Experience Manager** 
**,** 
 you become the trusted technical advisor for our clients. You ensure customers successfully onboard, integrate, and scale on Kapture’s platform while proactively solving complex technical challenges and driving long\-term value.
   

  

**Sounds interesting?**
 Here’s a more detailed description of what you will do in this role:
   

  

* You will lead client onboarding and integrations, working hands\-on with APIs, JSON payloads, and tools like Postman and cURL to ensure seamless adoption.
* You will own technical support and escalations, diagnosing issues using logs, Kafka, Grafana, Sentry, and collaborating closely with engineering and product teams to drive fast resolutions.
* You will build strong, trusted client relationships by acting as a technical advisor and advocate, translating complex concepts into clear, actionable insights.
* You will proactively identify optimization opportunities, conduct platform health checks, and recommend technical strategies to help clients maximize ROI.
* You will document issues, resolutions, and RCAs while sharing feedback and insights to influence product improvements and best practices.


 This is a
 **Delhi\-based role** 
 . We work five days a week from the office, as we believe in\-person interactions fuel innovation and agility.
   

  

**What does success look like in this role?**
 You consistently deliver smooth client experiences, resolve issues before they escalate, and help customers fully leverage Kapture’s platform to achieve measurable business impact.
   

  

**What would make you a good fit for this role?**
**Here Are The Basic Requirements**
* You have strong hands\-on experience with API integrations and system troubleshooting.
* You are comfortable working directly with enterprise clients and managing multiple priorities.
* You can collaborate effectively with engineering, product, sales, and support teams.
* You enjoy solving complex technical problems in fast\-paced environments.


**What are the most critical skills for this role?**
* You can debug issues by inspecting logs, tracing errors, and identifying root causes quickly.
* You are proficient with modern tech stacks and monitoring tools like Kafka, Grafana, and Sentry (or similar).
* You communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* You take ownership and think proactively about client success and platform optimization.


**You Will Have An Advantage If You**
* You have prior experience working with CRM platforms like Salesforce or HubSpot.
* You are comfortable working with SQL/NoSQL databases and understanding data flows.
* You have exposure to chatbot technologies or AI\-driven automation platforms.
* You enjoy creating clear documentation, troubleshooting guides, and RCAs.


**Why should you be interested?**
**Here’s What You Will Gain From This Role**
* An opportunity to work at the intersection of technology, clients, and business impact.
* Hands\-on exposure to large\-scale CX automation and AI\-powered platforms.
* Collaboration with highly skilled product, engineering, and customer success teams.
* Strong growth opportunities in a fast\-scaling global SaaS organization, along with competitive compensation and performance\-linked rewards.

title: Client Services Manager
description:
**Type:** 
 Full\-Time, Permanent
 



**Experience:** 
 8–15 years
 



**Location:** 
 Remote – Delhi NCR
 



**Salary:** 
 ₹18–25 LPA
 



**Industry Requirement:** 
 Candidates must have exclusive experience in the
 **Publishing Industry** 
 , preferably in academic, scholarly, scientific, technical, or digital publishing.
 



 Job Description
 



 The overall purpose of this position is to develop and implement programs and events that build customer relationships and drive usage, engagement, and awareness of digital publishing platforms, publications, and related products across multiple communities, including librarians, engineers, R\&D management, researchers, students, and faculty.
 



 The position will share accountability with sales and marketing management to:
 


* Build and maintain strong relationships with customers across India, the Middle East, Africa, CIS countries, and Bangladesh.
* Encourage usage and educate researchers, authors, librarians, administrators, and other stakeholders about digital publications, online libraries, authorship tools, and publishing platforms.
* Develop customer engagement initiatives that increase awareness, adoption, and usage of publishing products and platforms.
* Demonstrate strong resourcefulness and a solutions\-oriented approach while managing multiple priorities, timelines, and customer requirements.



 The position will be remote, based in the Delhi NCR area. This position has no direct reports.
 



 Specific Duties Include, but Are Not Limited To
 


* Plan, organize, and lead awareness, training, and customer support programs through online, hybrid, and in\-person formats.
* Develop and implement workshops, seminars, webinars, and events that educate customers and build long\-term relationships with librarians, authors, researchers, engineers, students, engineering management, and faculty.
* Collaborate with sales management, client services teams, and regional sales representatives to prioritize activities and plan efficient travel itineraries across academic, corporate, and government customers.
* Educate administrators and authors on Open Access publishing workflows, author tools, and related publishing processes.
* Assist with the introduction and adoption of new publishing products, digital platforms, and services.
* Support customers during the rollout of new subscriptions and monitor usage to encourage adoption and engagement with new content and platforms.
* Gather and communicate customer feedback to product development and design teams through regular reports, updates, and customer request tracking.
* Identify and report issues that affect customer access, usage, or overall experience and coordinate with relevant product and technical teams for resolution.
* Create client\-specific training and promotional materials, including video tutorials, presentations, flyers, user guides, and other educational content.
* Monitor emerging trends in library outreach, Open Access, scholarly communication, academic publishing, and digital content platforms.
* Manage university partnership programs, customer engagement initiatives, and events across the assigned territory.
* Travel as required to meet customers, conduct training programs, and support events across the assigned region.



 Qualifications
 


* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience from an accredited university or college.
* **8–15 years of relevant professional experience, with exclusive experience in the Publishing Industry.**
* Experience in academic, scholarly, scientific, technical, educational, or digital publishing will be highly preferred.
* Strong understanding of digital publishing platforms, online content, subscriptions, Open Access, scholarly communication, or library services.
* Excellent customer relationship management and stakeholder engagement skills.
* Strong presentation, training, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to engage effectively with librarians, researchers, authors, faculty, students, administrators, and senior stakeholders.
* Strong organizational and project coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently.
* Willingness to travel within the assigned territory as required.
* Strong proficiency in written and verbal English.

title: Client Relationship Manager
description:
CLIENT RELATIONSHIP \& ORDER MANAGEMENT MANAGER
 



  





 Company: A Luxury Interior Design Company
 



 Location: Delhi
 



 Experience: 4–7 years
 



 Industry Preference: Luxury furniture / interiors / premium retail / lifestyle / hospitality / real estate
 



 CTC Budget: ₹7–10 LPA, depending on experience and profile
 



  





 ABOUT COMPANY
 



  





 Its a premium furniture, interiors, styling and art curation brand, creating thoughtfully designed spaces for babies, children and adults. We work with discerning clients and HNI families and are expanding our interior styling and turnkey offerings.
 



  





 We are looking for a polished and highly organised Client Relationship \& Order Management Manager who can take ownership of the complete customer journey—from the first enquiry through conversion, order execution, delivery and post\-sale relationship management.
 



  





 ROLE OVERVIEW
 



  





 This is a client\-facing and execution\-oriented role.
 



  





 The candidate will be responsible for ensuring that every enquiry is systematically followed up, every converted client is properly managed, every order is tracked through execution, and clients receive timely and professional updates throughout the process.
 



  





 The ideal candidate will combine:
 



  





 Client Relationship Management \+ Sales Follow\-up \+ Order Coordination \+ Data/MIS Management
 



  





 The person should be comfortable dealing with HNI clients and simultaneously managing detailed trackers, reports and multiple ongoing orders.
 



  





 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 



  





 1\. Lead Management \& Follow\-up
 



  





 \* Handle incoming enquiries and ensure every lead is properly recorded.
 



 \* Understand client requirements, budgets, timelines and expectations.
 



 \* Maintain a structured lead and follow\-up database.
 



 \* Follow up with prospects systematically until conversion or closure.
 



 \* Ensure no lead is lost due to inadequate or delayed follow\-up.
 



 \* Maintain clear records of enquiry source, requirement, quotation, follow\-up dates and status.
 



 \* Track reasons for lost or inactive leads.
 



  





 2\. Sales \& Conversion
 



  





 \* Follow up on quotations and proposals.
 



 \* Coordinate with the sales/design team wherever required to move an enquiry towards closure.
 



 \* Maintain a clear pipeline of active, pending and converted leads.
 



 \* Track expected closures and provide regular updates to management.
 



 \* Build a strong understanding of TBS Studio’s products, services and positioning.
 



 \* Identify opportunities for upselling, cross\-selling and repeat business.
 



  





 3\. Client Relationship Management
 



  





 \* Act as a key point of contact for clients after enquiry/conversion.
 



 \* Develop strong and professional relationships with HNI and premium clients.
 



 \* Communicate with clients proactively regarding the status of their orders/projects.
 



 \* Ensure communication is polished, personalised and aligned with a premium/luxury brand.
 



 \* Handle client concerns professionally and ensure issues are followed through to resolution.
 



 \* Maintain a high level of discretion and professionalism when dealing with HNI clients.
 



  





 4\. Order \& Execution Management
 



  





 Once an order is confirmed, the candidate will be responsible for tracking its progress.
 



  





 \* Maintain an updated order tracker for every client.
 



 \* Coordinate with production, design, procurement, vendors and logistics.
 



 \* Track production status and expected completion dates.
 



 \* Monitor pending components, customisations and approvals.
 



 \* Identify delays or bottlenecks and escalate them proactively.
 



 \* Ensure internal teams are aligned with promised client timelines.
 



 \* Maintain a clear record of the complete order journey.
 



  





 5\. Delivery \& Installation Coordination
 



  





 \* Coordinate with the logistics/delivery team for dispatch and delivery.
 



 \* Confirm delivery schedules with clients.
 



 \* Ensure all items are ready before dispatch.
 



 \* Track delivery and installation completion.
 



 \* Communicate any delays or changes to clients proactively.
 



 \* Follow up after delivery to ensure client concerns, if any, are addressed.
 



  





 6\. Data, MIS \& Reporting
 



  





 A very important part of this role is maintaining accurate data and providing management with clear reports.
 



  





 The candidate will maintain:
 



  





 \* Lead tracker
 



 \* Follow\-up tracker
 



 \* Conversion report
 



 \* Quotation tracker
 



 \* Order tracker
 



 \* Production status tracker
 



 \* Delivery tracker
 



 \* Pending payment tracker
 



 \* Client status tracker
 



 \* Lost lead report
 



 \* Monthly sales and order MIS
 



  





 The candidate should be able to analyse the data and provide management with meaningful updates rather than simply maintaining spreadsheets.
 



  





 7\. Management Reporting
 



  





 Provide regular reports covering:
 



  





 \* New enquiries
 



 \* Active leads
 



 \* Follow\-ups due
 



 \* Quotations pending
 



 \* Conversion status
 



 \* Orders under execution
 



 \* Production status
 



 \* Delayed orders
 



 \* Upcoming deliveries
 



 \* Client issues
 



 \* Lost leads and reasons
 



 \* Sales/conversion performance
 



  





 IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE
 



  





 We are looking for someone who is:
 



  





 \* Highly organised and extremely good with follow\-ups.
 



 \* Strong in client relationship management.
 



 \* Comfortable handling HNI/UHNI and premium customers.
 



 \* Polished, articulate and well presented.
 



 \* Excellent in verbal and written communication.
 



 \* Strong with Excel/Google Sheets and data management.
 



 \* Comfortable preparing MIS and management reports.
 



 \* Detail\-oriented and process\-driven.
 



 \* Able to manage multiple clients/orders simultaneously.
 



 \* Proactive in identifying and resolving issues.
 



 \* Strong at coordination across different departments.
 



 \* Comfortable taking ownership rather than simply passing information.
 



 \* Able to work in a fast\-paced entrepreneurial environment.
 



 \* Commercially aware and focused on conversion and client retention.
 



  





 EXPERIENCE PREFERRED
 



  





 Candidates from the following industries will be preferred:
 



  





 \* Luxury furniture
 



 \* Interior design/interiors
 



 \* Premium/luxury retail
 



 \* Lifestyle brands
 



 \* Hospitality
 



 \* High\-end real estate
 



 \* Architecture/design firms
 



 \* Premium home décor
 



 \* Luxury automotive or other HNI\-facing businesses
 



  





 Experience dealing directly with HNI/UHNI clients will be an advantage.
 



  





 SKILLS REQUIRED
 



  





 Essential:
 



  





 \* Client Relationship Management
 



 \* Sales follow\-up
 



 \* Lead management
 



 \* Order/project coordination
 



 \* Excellent communication
 



 \* Excel / Google Sheets
 



 \* MIS/reporting
 



 \* Strong organisational skills
 



 \* Follow\-up and execution discipline
 



  





 Preferred:
 



  





 \* CRM software experience
 



 \* Experience in luxury/premium segment
 



 \* Experience with furniture/interiors
 



 \* HNI client management experience
 



  





 EDUCATION
 



  





 Graduate in any relevant discipline.
 



  





 Candidates with a background in Business, Sales, Marketing, Hospitality, Interior Design, Retail Management or related fields may be preferred.
 



  





 KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS
 



  





 Performance will be evaluated on:
 



  





 \* Lead follow\-up discipline
 



 \* Lead\-to\-conversion performance
 



 \* Sales conversion
 



 \* Accuracy of client/order data
 



 \* Timeliness of MIS reports
 



 \* Order execution tracking
 



 \* On\-time delivery coordination
 



 \* Client communication
 



 \* Resolution of client issues
 



 \* Repeat business and referrals
 



 \* Overall ownership of the client journey
 



  





 PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES
 



  





 The most important qualities we are looking for are:
 



  





 Ownership \| Follow\-through \| Organisation \| Client Sensitivity \| Communication \| Data Discipline \| Proactiveness
 



  





 The candidate should be someone who naturally asks:
 



  





 “What is pending, who is responsible, what is the next action and by when will it be completed?”
 



  





 rather than waiting for someone else to follow up.
 



  





 COMPENSATION
 



  





 ₹7–9LPA CTC, depending on experience, industry background and quality of HNI client\-handling experience.
 



  





 Performance\-linked incentives may be offered based on defined KPIs.

 Key Account Manager

 Not Disclosed

By digitizing manual supply chains with AI\-driven tools like FleekSort, you will manage the end\-to\-end lifecycle of key accounts, negotiating commercial terms and scaling inventory to meet the demands of 50,000 global buyers.

 Delhi, India

title: Account Technology
description:
**Overview**
 Synthesizes business insights and orchestrates global teams across the organization to deliver alternative solutions while applying deep expertise and thought leadership. Acts as a "virtual Chief Technical Officer" to provide Account Thought leadership in PSU / Government space, leverage deep knowledge of Microsoft's solutions, industry, and customer needs, and acts as the voice of the customer, industry, and team.
   

  

 Leads technology strategy formulation by leading alignment of customer needs and technology solutions, execution of technology strategy/digital transformation, creation of mid\- to long\-term technical roadmaps, and translation of customer business objectives.
   

  

 Develops and drives opportunities, presents opportunities to the customer, and creates demand. Coaches peers on how to create and maintain an opportunity initiation and how to map Microsoft priorities to opportunities.
   

  

 Leads digital transformation using corporate and cross\-industry resources, and partners with line\-of\-business leader or senior executive to articulate the benefits of Microsoft technology over competitor solutions.
   

  

 Helps customer technical specialists sell Microsoft offerings.
   

  

 Maps technical customer requirements and business scenarios to Microsoft technology platforms. Orchestrates necessary teams and partners to ensure demand generation and establishes best practices for account planning.
   

  

 Delivers regular industry/technology briefings to customer technology senior decision\-makers technical teams. Uses readiness resources and demonstrates expertise in creating enablement plans.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Customer and Industry Insights
   

  

 Applies expertise (deep expertise across few accounts or broad expertise across many accounts) and thought leadership to identify and inform the development of the right Industry Sales Kits and industry partners within the customer's vertical industry. Articulates and understands specific industry\-related market trends, as well as customer threats, opportunities, and barriers to growth as they relate to the customer's broader industry. Leverages industry trends from other industries to gather insights and develop an informed perspective on similar issues that may occur within their industry/industries. Applies industry knowledge to support customers in solving issues.
   

  

 Synthesizes and combines various business and industry insights from their team, global best practices, proof points from experience/case studies with countries and/or regions, and deep industry expertise (e.g., level 200\) related to customers and their competitors to conduct forecasting and develop recommendations for managing accounts and subsidiary planning. Ensures that all levels of the organization challenge customers to consider alternatives and adapt strategies, plans, business models, and solutions to insights. Orchestrates cross\-regional teams to gather information, collaborate on performance markers, and identify potential risks in customer accounts. Oversees technical teams for driving opportunities with others, as necessary. Brings in business and industry insights to address the broader business challenges for the customer and deliver solutions.
   

  

 Differentiated Value Proposition
   

  

 Partners with a line\-of\-business leader or senior executive within a large\-scale or high\-impact customer organization to articulate how complex Microsoft technology/services will meet future business needs better than the competition and will enable the achievement of long\-term growth and success. Provides an outside\-in view around existing and emerging compete or other solutions that are also a requirement for the customer.
   

  

 Acts as the customer's Technology Mentor in established relationships with a line\-of\-business leader or senior executive within a large\-scale or high\-impact customer organization senior leaders, including technical decision makers (TDMs) and/or Business Unit leaders at the C\-level (e.g., HR, Risk, Finance leadership). Develops extended relationships beyond core customers, advises on solutions, and aligns Microsoft capabilities with customer needs. Drives market share (e.g., cloud, collaboration, AI). Leads customer business transformations through digital technologies for assigned accounts to drive business outcomes and create business value for customers by understanding customer industry and position to provide guidance and to challenge customer thinking with innovative ideas that showcase the need for change and new strategic direction, and proactively involves corporate and cross\-industry resources to drive customer transformation. Ensures line\-of\-business wins are captured (e.g., customer write\-ups) as reference for scale, and represents the face of the business during public relations events for significant business wins.
   

  

 Education and Thought Leadership
   

  

 Leads customer technology engagement by engaging and influencing technical resources of customer, partner, and Microsoft towards customer’s business transformation. Delivers regular (e.g., quarterly, monthly) industry/technology briefings to customer technology senior decision\-makers technical teams.
   

  

 Uses existing and new readiness resources and demonstrates expertise in creating enablement plans for large and high\-stakes customers, and all\-up Microsoft business. Drives innovations to help customers meet capacity and capability goals, maximize reach, and impact and drive long\-term engagement and thought leadership on the Microsoft platform, and influences large customers to see and adopt the strategic value. Drives customer skilling initiatives and execution.
   

  

 Mapping and Account Planning
   

  

 Establishes best practices and standards around account planning for budgeting, quota attainment, consumption goals, and customer consumption gaps to inform quarterly and fiscal objectives. Coordinates highly complex extended account teams (e.g., spanning complex technologies, geographies, functions) and drives forecasting and tracking of the business. Owns the technical portion of the account plan and leads the customer plan delivery for large, critical, and/or strategic accounts. Captures all Account Planning input in MSX D365 Account Plan.
   

  

 Helps customer technical specialists build the message to sell Microsoft offerings to other parts of their business or end users. Creates stakeholder maps for accounts, determines, and orchestrates a coverage plan, and builds out an execution framework across multiple Rooms of the House of the customer.
   

  

 Orchestrates internal teams and local partners (inclusive of global systems integrators and consultancy partners) to ensure sufficient technical resources for demand generation, when appropriate.
   

  

 Technology Sales: Demand Generation and Orchestration
   

  

 Leads Account Strategy Envisioning (ASE, formerly IDTA) with the extended account team, customer, and partner to deliver the outcomes for the customer through joint envisioning, as a vehicle for Industry Sales Kits and Solution Plays. Creates new Stage 1 opportunities, both billed and consumed, with technical decision maker (TDM) customer stakeholders, managing consumption pipeline with extended team to maintain velocity, and unblocking issues. Coaches peers (often as a mentor across a region or country) on how to create and maintain an opportunity initiation and how to map Microsoft priorities to opportunities. Defines the blueprint for opportunity initiation, and sets and shares standards and best practices for others to follow.
   

  

 Leads the customer journey into the era of AI and Industrial Metaverse by creating a targeted approach tailored to their current business requirements and positions Microsoft as a leader for the future, both for accelerating productivity as well as helping the customer create new capabilities to support their business. Leverages expertise of current technology landscape and understanding of AI and Industrial Metaverse capabilities to plot the foundational elements on the technology roadmap that need to be in place to realize value for the customer. Builds a mid\-term strategy for AI and metaverse projects as well as an immediate opportunity pipeline and orchestrates execution through the appropriate technical teams from the Specialist Team Unit (STU) and with appropriate Partners
   

  

 Creates, develops, and drives opportunities based on industry best practices, presents opportunities to the customer, and creates demand. Develops a plan, within a broader strategy, to create and qualify a set number of opportunities for product sales, solutions sales, or consumption. Leverages partners and multiple channels (e.g., social media) to create demand. Orchestrates efforts to drive MCEM lifecycle and stage progression. Leverages experience and strategic foresight to lead technical teams by driving opportunities with Specialist Team Unit (STU), Customer Success Unit (CSU), and others, as necessary. Leads efforts to reach out to key stakeholders to give customer\-driven pitches and drives the appropriate customer reach together with the account executive to generate new demand. Uses advanced technical knowledge of products to determine feasibility of technical customer requirements requests and works with core engineering teams to prepare solutions.
   

  

 Technology Strategy Formulation
   

  

 Creates mid\- and long\-term (e.g., 12 or more months) multi\-horizon technology and business roadmaps for highly prominent, challenging, and/or strategic accounts based on a deep understanding of business and technology priorities and industry landscape. Challenges and validates the strategy and plan with customer stakeholders and drives envisioning and articulates business and program changes in the roadmaps around new and groundbreaking capabilities. Leads the translation of the customer's business objectives in conjunction with Industry Sales Kits and Solution Plays (including consumption\-heavy workloads and cloud services) to develop an effective Industry Technology Architecture to plans for and drives consumption and adoption of Microsoft cloud and a higher share of customer potential and propensity (CPP).
   

  

 Leads analysis of overall customer needs, outcomes, and blockers. Determines key stakeholders for driving execution on the largest and/or most complex accounts. Partners with global executives to lead overall strategy development (e.g., blocker identification, partner strategy) to identify and address gaps and drive end\-to\-end solutions. Leads the adoption of technologies by plotting the long\-term vision of the customer's business strategy and driving action to bring to fruition.
   

  

 Leads and ensures execution of technology strategy and digital transformation by anticipating and/or leading the resolution of technical blockers that arise during strategy planning and implementation, and driving technology adoption.
   

  

 Trusted Advisor
   

  

 Leverages a broad knowledge of Microsoft's product landscape, solutions, and strategy to address customer's needs. Proactively coordinates with internal and external network of industry experts (e.g., Regional Experts, industry\-specific partners) to build strong knowledge of the industry and the competitive landscape. Drives and leverages leaders from the partner ecosystem to bridge process gaps. Leverages deep understanding of their customer to share knowledge with extended team and leverages advanced knowledge of competitors to promote customer business perspectives. Partners with others (e.g., enterprise\-channel managers) to provide sponsorship and increase impact.
   

  

 Provides Account thought leadership inclusive of information technology (IT), business strategy knowledge, and technology landscape, and shares best practices internally while providing coaching to subsidiary resources. Leverages account thought leadership in partnership with account executives to set strategy, own accountability for outcomes, and lead extended teams. Provides technical guidance to internal teams to position technology while using customer landscape knowledge. Creates connections and feedback loops with Product and Engineering teams.
   

  

 Acts as the voice of the customer, industry, and internal advocate by providing insights, feedback, and challenges from the customer to internal teams (e.g., product groups, engineers) across all levels of the organization. Drives action to ensure that internal teams understand and respond to insights. Articulates the business opportunity for Microsoft based on product gaps.
   

  

 Creates security thought leadership with the customer's executives (e.g., technical decision maker \[TDM]/business decision maker \[BDM]) using the Microsoft Security and Zero Trust narratives and engages TDM and BDM stakeholders to position security as a business enabler and instill a security mindset in all aspects of the customer's technology landscape. Uses their understanding of the customers' technology and security needs to establish Microsoft’s security credentials and to build opportunities to improve the customer's security posture and orchestrates execution through security specialists.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Required/minimum qualifications
   

  

 Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business or related field AND 6\+ years technical consulting, technical consultative selling, business consulting, practice building, or related technical/sales experience OR equivalent experience.
   

  

**Additional Or Preferred Qualifications**
 Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business or related field AND 12\+ years technical consulting, technical consultative selling, business consulting, practice building, or related technical/sales experience OR equivalent experience.
   

  

 6\+ years experience in relevant customer industry.
   

  

 6\+ years experience in digital transformation, or using technology to drive customer business outcomes.
   

  

 This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. title: Team Leader
description:
**Job Title**
 Team Leader
   

  

**Job Description**
 The Team Leader, Operations is responsible for the day\-to\-day supervision of a group of call center associates. This position ensures performance metrics are achieved by providing adequate coaching, motivation and accountability.
   

  

**Essential Functions/Core Responsibilities**
* Responsible for the day\-to\-day supervision of a group of call center associates including work and attendance monitoring in accordance with organization policy and applicable legal requirements
* Effectively coach direct reports on their performance on a regular basis to ensure performance metrics are achieved at a minimum weekly
* Identify performance related issues, develop an action plan for improvement, implement corrective action, up to and including termination of employment
* Ensure service delivered to our customers meets contractual Key Performance Indicator (‘KPIs’) and financial expectations
* Communicate expectations to employees and provide timely updates
* Provide subject matter expertise in handling escalated customer calls as needed
* Conduct Team Meetings to ensure expedient communication of relevant information and as an open forum for input. Schedule and organize team activities
* Stay current on internal work processes, policies and procedures. Attend required manager development training
* Promote the Concentrix values through both behavior and attitude, including being an advocate for team members


 Candidate Profile
   

  

* Associate's degree in related field with two to four years of relevant experience preferred
* Highly motivated individual with skills to develop and coach team members to achieve performance expectations
* Work well under pressure and follow through on items to completion
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
* Ability to lead team in multi\-tasking, prioritization, and meeting timelines on deliverable
* Ability to mentor, coach and provide direction to a team of employees
* Willingness to work a flexible schedule


 Career Level Description
   

  

 Receives assignments in tasks oriented terms and supervises subordinates to set priorities and complete assignments. Coordinates and supervises the daily activities of business or technical support or production team members. In charge of handling single and medium\-sized line of business. Decisions are guided by policies, procedures and business plan; receives guidance and oversight from manager. Drives direct reports to achieve set metrics and business goals thru coaching, mentoring and providing regular feedback. Typically does not spend more than 20% of time performing the work supervised. Handles escalated issues. Supervises non\-exempt employees who generally perform either a single task or multiple, but closely related tasks.
   

  

 \<\< Philippines ONLY, Additional Description \>\>
   

  

* Manage the employment status of call center associates and participate in the transfer, promotions or regularization of call center associates, which is necessary before any such employee\-movement is made
* Exercises independent judgment and discretion in the performance of the said main function as a means to implement management policies
* Exercises authority to manage the employment status of a group of employees (firing, promotion, regularization, etc.) including identifying and addressing misconduct, policy and process violations of call center associates
* Stay current on internal work processes, management policies and procedures and ensures implementation of the same Implement management policies
* Support and manage the program together with other Team Leaders and Managers
* Providing input into selecting, training, developing, and completing performance appraisal of work group(s) in accordance with the organization’s policies and applicable legal requirements
* Manage team members on their performance on a regular basis, and write and deliver performance appraisal.
* The Team Leader’s role is a managerial level position, a position reposed with trust and confidence.

 The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel working within this job title.

title: AVP - Journey Excellence and Optimisation
description:
Join us as a "Senior Analyst \- Customer Journey Mapping, where you'll build analytical tools to generate insight, recognise patterns and predict behaviour, and deliver content direct to users of information products. You will work with technical teams, architects, designers, and administrators to overcome technical challenges and to make it happen. This role is responsible for supporting the design and delivery of end\-to\-end customer and colleague journey transformations across Barclays UK (BUK) Business Banking front \& back\-office operations and will contribute significantly to shaping Target Operating Models (TOMs) and eliminating process debt.
   

  

 The role is also responsible for ensuring the consistency and quality of process maps developed by journey mapping analysts, and for translating those maps into a business\-relevant narrative for wider stakeholder engagement providing a cohesive storyline of customer and colleague pain points, while identifying opportunities to deliver measurable improvements in customer experience, operational efficiency, and control effectiveness, in alignment with Barclays’ transformation strategy.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Journey \& Process Design**
* Translate complex operational challenges into simplified, scalable, and digitally enabled journeys.
* Support high\-impact process optimization engagements that enhance efficiency, customer experience, and risk management
* Oversee Customer Journey mapping analyst’s output (timeliness and overall quality)
* Provide support to Analysts by providing best\-practice guidance and conceptual support on journey mapping techniques, as required
* Integrate multiple journey variant maps to provide a consolidated view of related customer journeys
* Coordinate with stakeholders to obtain relevant data references that support effective journey visualisation
* Develop insightful visualizations that highlight customer pain points and identify opportunities to streamline processes and improve journey efficiency.


**Tooling \& Visualization**
* Use Figma, and Blueworks Live to map current and future state journeys.
* Maintain a centralised journey register and ensure traceability to customer outcomes and control requirements.


**Transformation Delivery \& Governance**
* Identify automation opportunities across journeys leveraging RPA, and AI/ML models
* Support the delivery of transformation initiatives, including business case development, benefit tracking, and stakeholder reporting.
* Ensure alignment with BUK’s transformation governance, including floorwalk showcases.


**To be successful as a "** 
**Senior Analyst \- Customer Journey Mapping" you should have experience with:**
**Essential Skills And Experience**
* Experience in Target Operating Model design and customer\-centric transformation delivery in Banking and financial services / Consulting / Global capability centers.
* Tooling: Expert level proficiency in Figma (UI/UX design), Blueworks Live (process mapping) and MS Power point (presentation and storytelling)
* Translate complex operational challenges into simplified, scalable, and digitally enabled journeys.
* Drive high\-impact process optimization engagements that enhance efficiency, customer experience, and risk management.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and translate into actionable insights.
* Strong problem\-solving skills to identify pain points in the customer journey.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across global and cross\-functional teams.


**Preferred Skills**
- Prior experience of working in / with:

* agile transformation environments
* Customer Experience / product teams
* Familiarity with Design thinking concepts.
* Familiarity with automation and AI technologies (e.g. RPA \- UiPath / Celonis / BluePrism / Automation Anywhere, Salesforce \& Agentforce, CoPilot Studio, Amazon Bedrock GenAI).


 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 This role will be based out of Noida/Gurugram.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To collaborate with stakeholders and use data and MI to identify process optimisation opportunities for capacity creation in relevant business areas.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Development and implementation of strategies to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of banking operations, using data led insights.
* Participation in projects and initiatives to improve performance \& optimisation efficiency and effectiveness.
* Development of reports and presentations on performance \& optimisation and communicate findings to internal senior stakeholders.
* Identification of industry trends and developments, and collaboration with stakeholders across the bank to provide recommendations for change and improvement within performance and optimisation processes.
* Development and implementation of analytics and reporting performance \& optimisation to mitigate risks and maintain efficient operations.
* Identification of capacity creation in operations using data and Management Information.


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

 You’ll bring passion, expertise, and a service\-first mindset to every interaction—helping customers navigate our platform and adopt it in ways that bring real value to their companies. Your goal is to build long\-lasting relationships grounded in trust, loyalty, and mutual success. You are “the representative” of Booking.com for Business for our corporate customers around the globe.
   

  

 On business events as well as via the phone and web meetings, you will contact, attract, connect and inform corporate customers of our product and services. You will share your knowledge, your passion with our customers and teams and guide them in using Booking.com for Business to best fit them and their company’s needs.
   

  

 Your goal is to build up a long term relationship full of trust and loyalty towards Booking.com for Business. Furthermore you will become an expert in the Business Travel industry and continuously enrich your knowledge in this area for and with all stakeholders involved.

title: Key Account Manager
description:
**About Virohan:** 




 Founded about a decade ago by Kunaal Dudeja, Nalin Saluja, and Archit Jayaswal, Virohan is an
 **education–to\-industry partner** 
 building the workforce powering India’s healthcare future. We partner with universities and colleges across India to deliver industry\- aligned programs in Healthcare and management, helping students bridge the gap between education and real\-world employability. At Virohan, we believe healthcare education needs to go beyond classrooms.
 **Our model combines academic learning with hands\-on industry exposure and strong healthcare partnerships, ensuring students are prepared for real roles.** 
 Today, Virohan has trained 13,000\+ healthcare professionals, with a growing network of university and industry partners across the country.
 



 Backed by
 **global investors including Blume Ventures (India), Mynavi Corporation (Japan), Rebright Partners (Japan), Elea Foundation (Switzerland), Artha Impact (Switzerland), Bharat Inclusive Technologies Seed Fund (India), and Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance Venture Capital (Japan),** 
 we are building at the intersection of education and healthcare — two of India’s fastest\-growing sectors.
 



  





**Why this role exists** 




 Signing a university partnership is the easy part. Making it work — filling seats, running the programme well, placing students, keeping the Registrar and the Chancellor’s office confident that the partnership was a good decision — is where the business is actually won or lost. And it all comes due once a year, at renewal.
 



 This role owns that. You are the single point of accountability for a portfolio of partner universities: their success, their satisfaction, and their renewal. You are the bridge between the institution and every internal team at Virohan — admissions, academics, placements, operations, finance — translating in both directions, setting expectations honestly, and making sure what we promised is what actually happens on campus.
 



  





**What you’ll own** 




 •
 **Renewal targets\-** 
 Carry and deliver the end\-of\-year renewal goal for every university in your portfolio. Renewals are the number you are measured on, and you own the plan to get there from day one of the year — not in the last quarter.
 



 •
 **Partner success\-** 
 Define what success looks like for each partner — enrolment, programme delivery, student outcomes, placements — then track it, report it, and drive the internal action that moves it.
 



 •
 **The relationship map\-** 
 Build trusted relationships across each institution: Registrar, Deans, HoDs, admissions teams, and the leadership who ultimately sign the renewal. Never be dependent on a single contact.
 



 •
 **Expectation setting\-** 
 Agree what Virohan will deliver and what the university will deliver, in writing, up front — and hold both sides to it. Most partnership failures are expectation failures.
 



 •
 **Internal advocacy and escalation\-** 
 Represent the partner\&\#39;s reality inside Virohan and get cross\- functional teams to act, without having authority over them. Escalate early, with evidence, and follow through to closure.
 



 •
 **Business reviews\-** 
 Run a disciplined cadence of reviews with each partner — a clear numbers\-led narrative on what is working, what is not, and what happens next. These reviews are what make the renewal conversation a formality.
 



 •
 **Commercial conversations\-** 
 Lead renewal negotiations, pricing and scope discussions, and identify expansion within existing partners — new programmes, new campuses, higher intake.
 



 •
 **Risk detection\-** 
 Spot an at\-risk account two quarters out, not two weeks out. Build the early\-warning signals into how you run the portfolio.
 



  





**What we’re looking for** 




 •
 **3\-6 years of experience in business roles,** 
 with real ownership of a number — retention, renewal, revenue or growth. You have been accountable for an outcome, not just for supporting one.
 



 •
 **Outstanding communication.** 
 You are credible in a Registrar\&\#39;s office and clear in an internal escalation. You can say no, deliver bad news early, and still keep the relationship strong.
 



 •
 **Logical, structured thinking.** 
 You diagnose why an account is underperforming rather than reacting to the loudest complaint, and you can separate a real problem from a symptom.
 



 •
 **Comfort with numbers.** 
 You are fluent in spreadsheets and you run your portfolio off data —
 



 enrollment funnels, placement rates, revenue per partner, renewal probability. You build your own view rather than waiting for a report.
 



 •
 **Strong AI leverage.** 
 You already use Claude and similar AI tools to prepare for reviews, analyse partner data, draft proposals and cut your admin time. We want someone who compounds their own output.
 



 •
 **Clear writing.** 
 Review decks, partner emails, MoU scopes and internal escalations that are
 



 unambiguous and get acted on.
 



 •
 **Ownership and follow\-through.** 
 You close loops without being chased. When something falls between two teams, you pick it up.
 



 •
 **Willingness to travel.** 
 You will be on partner campuses regularly. The relationship is not built over email.
 



  





**This role is probably not for you if** 




 • You see account management as relationship maintenance rather than a number you carry.
 



 • You are uncomfortable pushing internal teams, or you avoid difficult conversations with a partner until they escalate.
 



 • You would rather report on the portfolio than be accountable for it.
 



  





**What you get** 




 •
 **A clear number and real ownership** 
 — your portfolio, your renewal target, your call on how to get there.
 



 •
 **Senior exposure** 
 , internally with Virohan’s leadership and externally with university leadership, from your first month.
 



 •
 **Work that matters** 
 — every partnership that renews is another few hundred students with a route to a real healthcare job.
 



  





**If you believe in making an impact on society and are keen to be a part of the fast growing healthcare education sector, we would be delighted to hear from you!**

* Prepare and present campaign reports, performance updates, insights, and recommendations to clients.

* Coordinate multiple campaigns and client requirements simultaneously while ensuring timelines and quality standards are met.
* Build strong relationships with clients and internal stakeholders and proactively address campaign\-related queries or challenges.

* Maintain proper documentation of campaign plans, timelines, budgets, deliverables, and performance reports.

* Good understanding of digital campaign metrics and the ability to interpret campaign performance.

 Digital Marketing \| Meta Ads \| Media Planning \| Client Servicing \| Account Management \| Campaign Management \| Performance Marketing \| Campaign Reporting \| Client Communication \| MS Excel \| Digital Media \| Stakeholder Management

 Where required liaise directly with clients regarding complex client requests in respect of various banking and servicing requirements such as onboarding, banking transactions, Investments, credit \& digital solutions.

Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes

The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.

They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Manager, Knowledge Management Services, GESS - Global Capability Center
description:
**Description**
**About Alvarez \& Marsal**
 Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm with entrepreneurial, action and results\-oriented professionals. We take a hands\-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work \- guided by A\&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity \- are why our people love working at A\&M.
   

  

**The Team**
 We are seeking an enthusiastic, self\-motivated knowledge management professional to join our growing KM Services team. As part of A\&M’s Global AI and Knowledge Organization, KM Services is at the center of an exciting firm\-wide transformation in how A\&M works and derives value from its intellectual property. The team is focused on building a mature knowledge management practice, including strengthening relationships with business stakeholders; breaking down siloes; and improving how consulting teams capture, organize, share, and find critical knowledge. In addition to supporting people\-to\-people and people\-to\-content use cases, the team has a critical role in building the data and information layer needed to power business\-relevant AI agents and tools. The successful candidate will own the KM relationship for a portfolio of India business units, partnering closely with those businesses to improve their existing KM processes, understand their evolving needs, and connect them to the global KM strategy and toolkit. This is a high\-visibility role for someone who wants to help business units get more value from their knowledge while also contributing directly to global KM and AI initiatives. The role will report to the EMEA \& India KM Services Director
   

  

**How You Will Contribute**
* Partner with A\&M Business Units on KM Initiatives
* Own the day\-to\-day KM relationship for India business units, with the opportunity to expand the portfolio over time
* Serve as the primary liaison between assigned business units and the central KM team, identifying opportunities to extend each business unit’s use of KM services and maximize KM adoption and value
* Lead projects to build and refine business\-unit KM processes and tools, including coordinating timelines and partnering with KM services, KM technology, and other corporate groups on execution
* Monitor and provide routine support for business\-unit KM processes and tools (e.g., knowledge libraries, taxonomies, capture processes, search, and communities)
* Provide advice and recommendations to business units based on internal and external KM best practices.
* Contribute to KM Knowledge and Expertise
* Partner with KM colleagues to design and build global capabilities and tools (e.g., expert profiles, conversational knowledge search, agentic knowledge capture) and help extend them to new areas of the business
* Support KM team members on initiatives both within and beyond the immediate region, contributing to a cohesive global KM capability
* Share knowledge of processes, approaches, methods, and tools/platforms with team colleagues so the team can leverage its collective experience across the globe
* Provide insight into business needs, initiatives, and end\-user experience to help ensure global KM service offerings remain relevant and aligned to overall strategy
* Support the growth and evolution of the KM team by applying KM best practices in ways that strengthen the success of the overall KM support model
* AI Risk \& Audit
* Identify internal and external KM trends and best practices; communicate and promote these to business\-unit KM contacts
* Champion KM best practices and encourage knowledge sharing and adoption of new tools throughout the region and firm


**Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of experience in a knowledge management role
* Bachelor’s degree in a related field, or equivalent work/technical experience in Business Studies, Business Administration, or Management
* Experience leading projects from inception to completion, including collaborating with stakeholders on timelines and expectations and handling change management
* Experience in a professional services or consultancy firm
* Proven experience working with professionals of all staff classes, up to C\-level
* Experience with KM technology (e.g., SharePoint libraries, AI\-enabled search and discovery tools)
* Fluent English required. Additional languages (Mandarin, Cantonese, Japanese, or Korean) are a plus but not required
* Consultative approach when partnering with the business
* Experience with KM and content management approaches (e.g., communities, skills and experience platforms, document libraries, taxonomy and metadata, search, curation, content analytics)
* Analytical reasoning and solution\-focused problem solving, with the ability to connect the dots and scale KM efforts across a portfolio of business units
* Capable of synthesizing information and driving results in a fast\-paced environment
* Ability to balance multiple projects and prioritize effectively
* Excellent communication and listening skills, with the ability to present complex ideas and solutions to technical and non\-technical audiences
* Demonstrated history of operating with urgency, responsiveness, and a client\-first focus
* Exceptionally close attention to detail
* Resilience and an ability to persevere in order to break down resistance and accomplish long\-term goals


**Your journey at A\&M**
 We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top\-notch training and on\-the\-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well\-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A\&M. The possibilities are endless for high\-performing and passionate professionals.

 years

 Audience expansion
 



 New platforms
 



 New campaign formats

 Creative testing
 



 Landing\-page optimization
 



 Funnel optimization

title: Brand Category Manager
description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech\-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.
   

  

 We're building one of India's most interesting marketing teams in the mobility space, and we need someone who can own a portfolio of channels the way a brand manager owns a category: with commercial instinct, cross\-functional pull, and a genuine drive to grow.
   

  

 This isn't a coordination role \-you will own Brand partnerships, offline distribution, and OTA set strategy, run execution, and be accountable for outcomes. You'll work directly with the India Leadership and also operate as a key node between local teams and global stakeholders.
   

  

 If you've grown up in FMCG or a fast\-scaling startup and know what it means to own a channel from the ground up, this is the job.
   

  

**About The Role**
* You think about the Flix brand in India with both a short and long term lens. Contributing to how the brand shows up across your channels today while helping shape the positioning and perception we want to build over the next 3 to 5 years
* Build and manage Flix's B2B and brand partnership pipeline in India. Identifying prospects, closing deals, onboarding partners, and tracking commercial contribution to load
* Be the external face of Flix on OTA platforms, owning platform relationships, content quality, listing health, and commercial terms across all major OTA partners in India
* Manage the offline sales network. Travel agencies, ticket shops, and kiosks — from acquisition through to partner enablement, training, and performance management
* You collaborate across marketing, performance, CRM, and product to prevent channel strategies from running in silos and to unlock shared growth levers
* Identify and pursue new distribution and partnership opportunities in the Indian market, bringing commercial rigour to everything from a first pitch to a signed deal
* You liaise with HQ and global teams to keep local channel strategies aligned with Flix's broader commercial and brand direction
* You act as the primary external point of contact for partners across B2B, offline, and OTA, representing Flix with authority


**About You**
* 3 to 5 years in brand management, category management, or channel marketing, ideally in D2C, or a high\-growth startup
* You've owned marketing spends or a channel target before, not just reported into one.
* Comfortable managing a wide portfolio without losing depth on what matters most.
* Strong negotiator and relationship builder. You can hold a room with a internal teams, external partner and on ground sales agents in the same day.
* Sharp with numbers, fast with decisions, and honest about what's working


 We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!
   

  

**What We Offer**
* Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers \+ 12 discount vouchers for friends \& family.
* Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year.
* Hybrid work model: We are an office\-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life.
* Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members.
* Learning \& Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert\-led sessions to grow your skills.
* Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career.


 To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations \- Flix Career
   

  

**Why Join Flix?**
 At Flix, you’ll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture \- giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.
   

  

 As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.
   

  

 If you’re ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

title: Operations Director
description:
**Overview**
**170\+ Years Strong. Industry Leader. Global Impact.** 
 At Pinkerton, the mission is to protect our clients. To do this, we provide enterprise risk management services and programs specifically designed for each client. Pinkerton employees are one of our most important assets and critical to the delivery of world\-class solutions. Bonded together, we share a commitment to integrity, vigilance, and excellence.
   

  

 Pinkerton is an inclusive employer who seeks candidates with diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives to join our team of industry subject matter experts.
   

  

 The Operations Director – Pinkerton India leads end\-to\-end service delivery across Pinkerton’s EPIC portfolio (Embed, Protect, Investigate, Consult) to ensure outstanding client outcomes, rigorous accountability, and optimal cost\-to\-value. This role orchestrates multi\-service operations, vendor/partner networks, and internal teams to deliver on\-time, in\-scope, and within\-budget results. The Director drives a culture of ownership, safety, integrity, vigilance, and excellence while scaling processes, enhancing quality, and meeting or exceeding contractual SLAs and KPIs.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Represent Pinkerton’s core values of integrity, vigilance, and excellence.
* Serve as the senior operations point of contact for client accounts in India, aligning scope, priorities, and SLAs with Pinkerton’s EPIC model.
* Coordinate services and operational/administrative support needs; oversee dispatch, scheduling, and reporting across assignments and programs.
* Answer and triage escalations from clients, Directors, and Operations Coordinators, ensure swift, transparent communication and resolution.
* Communicate assignment/project expectations, timelines, risks, and success criteria to all parties; maintain impeccable documentation.
* Design, standardize, and enforce SOPs, operational playbooks for consistent delivery across regions and service lines.
* Manage workflows end\-to\-end; assign agents and specialist resources to specific assignments based on capability, compliance, and cost.
* Track program milestones and deadlines; monitor the status of assigned projects and initiate course\-corrections proactively.
* Utilize scorecards to measure activities and outcomes (e.g., Deployable Assets programs), driving continuous improvement.
* Track results and issue reports on completed work, non\-conformities, corrective and improvement plans; own CAPA closure.
* Ensure deadlines are met for scheduling, dispatching, audits, and post checks; verify outcomes (vendor hour approvals, virtual/onsite post checking).
* Send and manage external partner self\-assessments and security questionnaires using approved web\-based tools; drive timely completion and remediation.
* Lead root\-cause analyses, implement preventive actions, and institutionalize lessons learned across teams and vendors.
* Build and govern a high\-performing vendor ecosystem (including Global Alliance Members where applicable) with clear rate cards, SLAs, and compliance obligations.
* Negotiate, onboard, and performance\-manage vendors; conduct QBRs, enforce service credits, and manage escalations to protect client outcomes and margin.
* Optimize vendor utilization, travel/logistics, and deployment patterns to balance speed, quality, risk, and cost.
* Own operational budgeting, forecasting, and margin protection; drive cost\-per\-outcome efficiency without compromising quality or safety.
* Implement demand planning, capacity models, and pricing/quoting discipline; monitor variance and initiate corrective actions.
* Improve invoice accuracy, WIP hygiene, and cycle times; partner with Finance on revenue recognition and profitability.
* Ensure compliance with PSARA, Contract Labour (Regulation \& Abolition) Act, Shops \& Establishments, PoSH, client codes of conduct, and data privacy/information security requirements.
* Maintain audit readiness; coordinate internal/external audits and remediation plans.
* Champion agent safety through virtual and on\-site post checks, journey management, and incident reporting protocols.
* Hire, coach, and develop a high\-performing operations team; set clear goals and hold teams and vendors accountable.
* Foster a culture of integrity, vigilance, excellence, transparency, and client\-obsession; recognize strong performance and address underperformance promptly.
* Drive change management and cross\-functional collaboration with Sales, Finance, Legal, HR, and Regional Ops.
* All other duties, as assigned.


**Qualifications**
 Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or equivalent advanced degree preferred. 12–15 years of progressive experience in corporate security/operations or adjacent services, including multi\-vendor orchestration and client service delivery. Experience with escalation/crisis management, incident response coordination, and audit/quality systems. Certifications preferred: CPP, PSP, PMP, Lean Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt) or equivalent.
   

  

* Accountability and ownership mindset; data\-driven decisioning; strong financial acumen.
* Vendor negotiation, rate\-card governance, and performance management.
* Program/Project management, capacity planning, and resource optimization.
* Risk assessment, SOP design, and continuous improvement (Kaizen/CAPA/RCA).
* High integrity, vigilance, and excellence aligned to Pinkerton values.
* Fluency in English and Hindi; additional Indian languages an advantage.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; ability to influence at executive level.
* Proven leadership of national programs with measurable SLA/KPI achievement and cost optimization.
* Strong knowledge of India regulatory environment (PSARA, CLRA, Shops \& Establishments, PoSH) and client compliance expectations.
* Proficiency with scheduling/dispatch platforms, CRM/ITSM tools (e.g., Salesforce/ServiceNow), and collaboration suites.
* Advanced Excel; reporting/BI (Power BI/Tableau) for scorecards and operational insights.
* Web\-based tools for self\-assessments/security questionnaires; audit and document control systems.


**Working Conditions**
 With or without reasonable accommodation, requires the physical and mental capacity to effectively perform all essential functions;
   

  

* Regular computer usage.
* Occasional reaching and lifting of small objects and operating office equipment.
* Frequent sitting, standing, and/or walking.
* Travel, as required.


 Pinkerton is an equal opportunity employer to all applicants and positions without regard to race/ethnicity, color, national origin, ancestry, sex/gender, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, marital/prenatal status, pregnancy/childbirth or related conditions, religion, creed, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any protected status by local, state, federal or country\-specific law.

 To efficiently manage and resolve crew support issues by addressing complaints, queries, and suggestions. Provide strong leadership and mentorship to the team, driving continuous improvements in service quality and operational efficiency. The candidate must be data\-driven, with the ability to use operational data, trends, and insights as an important factor in decision\-making, performance tracking, and process improvement. Ensure all support activities adhere to SLAs, maintain high standards of support, and foster positive relationships with both crew members and internal staff. Develop and implement strategies to enhance team performance, optimize processes, and uphold the organization's commitment to excellence.
   

  

**Qualification \& Experience**
* Minimum of Bachelor's degree from a recognized university or professional qualifications in business and people management or equivalent.
* Completion or perusal of post\-graduation would be an added advantage.
* Overall work experience of 8 years and above with a minimum four years' experience in crew management / operation in aviation.


**Skill Set**
* Fluent in English with strong communication skills.
* Managed a team of ten or more professionals.
* Knowledge of airline crew rostering system.
* Ability to work under pressure and manage rotational shifts.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and MS Word.
* Expertise in advanced Excel capabilities including pivot tables, lookups, dashboards, charts, conditional formatting, and trend analysis for leadership\-ready reporting.
* Ability to create interactive dashboards and basic working knowledge of Power BI for data visualization and analytics.
* Knowledge of aviation operations is a must.
* Ability to leverage AI tools responsibly to enhance efficiency, communication, and analytics.


**Key Competencies**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Data\-driven approach with the ability to interpret trends, validate numbers, and convert insights into practical action plans.
* Excellent organizational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks.
* Effective at building relationships and leading teams.
* Experience in process evaluation and improvement.
* Strong leadership presence with focus on punctuality, professional conduct, grooming standards, and communication excellence.
* Ability to build a learning\-oriented culture through cross\-training and capability enhancement.
* Storytelling and data visualization expertise for creating executive\-level presentations and dashboards.


**Job Responsibilities**
* Deliver comprehensive support by addressing and resolving complaints, queries, and suggestions from Crew and internal staff efficiently.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with team members, stakeholders, and other departments through effective communication and collaboration.
* Ensure all tickets, requests, feedback, and queries are responded and monitored in accordance with the 48\-hour SLA.
* Collaborate with various departments to resolve cross\-functional issues and drive continuous process improvements.
* Conduct quality audits, analyse support processes, set service metrics, and implement changes to enhance overall crew support quality.
* Develop and implement Key Result Areas (KRAs) for team members, aligning their objectives with departmental and organizational goals.
* Conduct regular performance reviews, sharing feedback and performance updates with team members, and identifying areas for improvement and professional development.
* Manage departmental operations by overseeing daily tasks, coordinating projects, and ensuring timely completion of assigned responsibilities.
* Uphold a positive, transparent, and trustworthy image of ICare with clients, addressing their needs and concerns effectively.
* Stay current with the latest CAR and DGCA regulations to ensure compliance and integrate relevant updates into support practices.
* Demonstrate strong analytical, problem\-solving, and organizational skills to address complex issues and improve processes.
* Exhibit leadership by managing and mentoring the team, fostering a supportive environment, and ensuring effective team performance, especially in the absence of higher management.
* Monitor team performance, analyse performance metrics, share regular updates with the leadership, and ensure targets are met. Provide coaching and support to enhance team capabilities and address any performance issues.
* Communicate updates, issues, challenges, and proposed solutions to senior leadership, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and facilitating informed decision\-making.
* Ensure readiness for 24x7 operations by managing rotational shift requirements, team coverage planning, and operational contingencies.
* Drive punctuality, professional conduct, grooming standards, and high\-quality communication within the team.
* Build a learning\-oriented culture by promoting cross\-training, skill development, and capability enhancement across functions.
* Analyze operational performance metrics including ticket volumes, SLA adherence, aging, reopen rates, quality scores, productivity trends, and recurring concerns to identify improvement opportunities.
* Leverage advanced Excel capabilities and create interactive dashboards using Power BI (basic level) to produce leadership\-ready reports and analytical insights.
* Promote responsible adoption of AI tools to improve efficiency, enhance communication quality, support analytics, and reduce manual effort.
* Develop professional presentations, dashboards, and management reports with clear storytelling, meaningful insights, and visually effective content for senior leadership and EXCO reviews.
* Coach and guide team members on reporting standards, analytical skills, AI adoption, presentation effectiveness, and dashboard creation.
