title: Integrated Solutions Service Tech 4
description:
**Job Summary**
 The Service Manager \- Applied HVAC Chiller is responsible for leading service operations, maintenance programs, troubleshooting activities, and customer support for applied HVAC systems, including centrifugal, screw, scroll, absorption chillers, cooling towers, pumps, and associated controls. The role ensures high customer satisfaction, operational excellence, service revenue growth, and compliance with safety and quality standards.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Service Operations Management
   

  

* Lead and manage the service team responsible for installation, commissioning, preventive maintenance, breakdown support, and retrofit projects for HVAC chiller systems.
* Ensure timely resolution of customer complaints and critical equipment outages.
* Monitor service KPIs, response times, and customer service levels.
* Plan and allocate manpower, tools, and resources effectively.


 Technical Leadership
   

  

* Provide technical expertise for applied HVAC systems, including:
+ Centrifugal Chillers
+ Screw Chillers
+ Air\-Cooled Chillers
+ Water\-Cooled Chillers
+ Cooling Towers
+ Pumps and Hydronic Systems
+ Building Management Systems (BMS)
+ Chiller Plant Optimization Solutions

* Support root cause analysis for recurring equipment failures.
* Guide field engineers on complex troubleshooting and repair activities.


 Customer Relationship Management
   

  

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with key customers, consultants, facility managers, and contractors.
* Conduct regular customer reviews and service performance meetings.
* Identify opportunities for service contract renewals, upgrades, retrofits, and modernization projects.


 Business Growth \& Revenue Management
   

  

* Drive annual maintenance contract (AMC) and comprehensive maintenance contract (CMC) renewals.
* Achieve service revenue and profitability targets.
* Identify cross\-selling and upselling opportunities within the customer base.
* Support sales teams during technical discussions and service\-related proposals.


 Team Management
   

  

* Recruit, train, mentor, and develop service engineers and technicians.
* Conduct performance evaluations and skill development programs.
* Foster a culture of accountability, safety, and continuous improvement.


 Safety \& Compliance
   

  

* Ensure adherence to EHS standards and company safety policies.
* Conduct periodic safety audits and toolbox talks.
* Maintain compliance with local regulations, HVAC industry standards, and quality management systems.


 Reporting \& Documentation
   

  

* Monitor service reports, maintenance records, and customer documentation.
* Track service KPIs such as:
+ First\-time fix rate
+ Mean Time to Repair (MTTR)
+ Customer Satisfaction Score (CSAT)
+ Contract Renewal Rate
+ Service Revenue Achievement

* Prepare monthly operational and financial performance reports.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, HVAC Engineering, or related field.
* MBA is an added advantage.


**Experience**
* 8\-15 years of experience in HVAC service operations.
* Minimum 3\-5 years of experience in managing applied HVAC/chiller service teams.
* Experience with leading HVAC manufacturers such as Carrier, Trane, Johnson Controls, Daikin, York, Mitsubishi Electric, or equivalent is preferred.

title: Business Head  – Government Business & Strategic Projects
description:
**Business Head – Government Business \& Strategic Projects** 




  






 Company: Intozi Tech Pvt. Ltd.
 





 Location: Delhi NCR / Gurugram
 





 Experience: 20\+ Years
 





 Function: Government Business, Sales \& Strategic Projects
 




  





**Role Overview** 





 Intozi is looking for a senior leader with 20\+ years of experience in Government business and large technology/infrastructure projects to lead our Government vertical.
 





 This is not purely a sales or relationship\-management position. We are looking for someone who has handled the complete end\-to\-end lifecycle of large Government projects—from identifying and shaping an opportunity to tendering, order closure, project execution, acceptance, payment collection and long\-term account management.
 





 The candidate should also have a strong network and established relationships across Government departments, Smart Cities, Safe Cities, Police, Traffic Police, Municipal Corporations/MCD, Defence, PSUs, consultants and System Integrators.
 




  





**Key Areas of Experience** 





 The candidate should preferably have worked on large projects involving:
 



* Smart City \& Safe City
* CCTV Surveillance \& Video Analytics
* Integrated Command \& Control Centres (ICCC)
* Intelligent Traffic Management Systems (ITMS)
* Traffic Enforcement \& e\-Challan
* Police \& Homeland Security
* Municipal Corporations / MCD / Urban Local Bodies
* Defence \& Critical Infrastructure
* AI\-based Video Analytics
* Networking, Data Centre, Cloud and ICT infrastructure
* Large Government system\-integration projects



  





**End\-to\-End Project Ownership** 





 The candidate must have hands\-on experience across the complete Government project lifecycle, including:
 





 1\. Opportunity Identification \& Account Development
 





 Identify upcoming Government projects, budgets and opportunities well before the tender is published.
 





 Build relationships with Government decision\-makers, consultants, PMCs, Smart City SPVs, Police departments, municipal bodies and other stakeholders.
 





 2\. Requirement Understanding \& Solution Conceptualisation
 





 Understand the customer's operational requirements and work with technical teams to develop the overall solution architecture, scope, BoQ and implementation approach.
 





 3\. Pre\-RFP \& Tender Shaping
 





 Engage with customers, consultants and ecosystem partners during DPR, RFP and specification\-development stages.
 





 Understand technical specifications, eligibility criteria, PQ requirements, SLAs and commercial conditions.
 





 4\. Tender \& Bid Management
 





 Take ownership of bid strategy, including:
 



* Tender qualification and Go/No\-Go
* Technical and commercial bid strategy
* OEM and partner selection
* Consortium/JV strategy where required
* MAF and compliance requirements
* Technical specifications and BoQ
* Commercial costing
* Competition analysis
* Pre\-bid meetings and clarifications
* Technical presentations and demonstrations




 5\. Commercial Negotiation \& Order Closure
 





 Lead commercial negotiations with customers, SIs, partners and other stakeholders through final contract/PO closure.
 





 The candidate should understand payment terms, PBG/EMD, LD clauses, SLA penalties, warranty, AMC and other contractual obligations.
 





 6\. Project Execution \& Stakeholder Management
 





 Remain actively involved after order closure and work closely with project and technical teams for successful execution.
 





 Experience should include coordination with:
 



* Government customers
* System Integrators
* OEMs
* Consultants/PMCs
* Project teams
* Subcontractors
* Site teams and other stakeholders




 The candidate should understand implementation challenges associated with large multi\-location Government technology projects.
 





 7\. Testing, Acceptance \& Go\-Live
 





 Experience managing project milestones including:
 



* FAT
* Site deployment
* Integration
* UAT
* SAT
* Go\-Live
* Customer acceptance
* SLA compliance
* Project handover




 8\. Billing, Collection \& Project Closure
 





 The candidate should understand the commercial lifecycle beyond winning the order, including:
 



* Milestone billing
* Customer acceptance documentation
* Invoice approvals
* Payment follow\-up
* Receivables management
* PBG/retention release
* Project closure




 9\. AMC \& Account Expansion
 





 Develop the account beyond the initial project through AMC, additional licenses, capacity expansion, new use cases and additional projects.
 




  





**Candidate Profile** 





 We are specifically looking for someone who:
 



* Has 20\+ years of experience, preferably with significant Government/PSU exposure.
* Has personally managed large Government projects from opportunity identification through final payment/closure.
* Has strong relationships across Smart Cities, Safe Cities, Police, Traffic Police, Municipal Corporations/MCD, Defence and Government departments.
* Understands both sales and project execution, rather than having experience only in tender participation.
* Has experience working with large System Integrators, OEMs, EPC players, consultants and PMCs.
* Understands Government tendering, GeM, RFPs, PQ criteria, consortiums, contracts, PBG/EMD, SLAs and payment processes.
* Can engage with senior Government officials as well as technical/project teams.
* Has experience handling large\-value, multi\-stakeholder and multi\-location projects.
* Has strong commercial negotiation and stakeholder\-management capabilities.
* Can take complete revenue, order\-book, execution and collection responsibility for strategic Government accounts.



  





**Preferred Previous Roles** 





 Candidates may currently or previously have held positions such as:
 





 VP – Government Business
 





 Business Head – Government \& PSU
 





 Director – Government Business
 





 National Head – Government \& Smart Cities
 





 Business Head – Smart \& Safe Cities
 





 Government \& Defence Business Head
 





 Strategic Projects Head
 




  





**What We Are Looking For** 





 We are not looking only for a Government salesperson who can bring leads or participate in tenders.
 





 We are looking for a senior business leader who understands how a ₹10 Cr–₹100\+ Cr Government technology project moves through its entire lifecycle:
 





 Opportunity → Customer Engagement → Solution → DPR/RFP → Tender → Bid → Negotiation → PO/Contract → Execution → Integration → UAT/SAT → Go\-Live → Billing → Collection → AMC/Expansion
 





 The person should have the relationships to open doors, the commercial experience to win projects, and the execution understanding to take responsibility until successful project and commercial closure.

 Over the past seven years, we've consistently achieved milestones that take other companies a decade or more. During this time, we've significantly grown our employee base, expanded our customer reach, and rapidly advanced our product capabilities.

 Our founders saw that traditional security didn't work for the cloud, so they set out to carve a new path. We're relentless pioneers who invented agentless technology and continue to be the most comprehensive and innovative cloud security company.

 With a valuation of $1\.8 billion, Orca is a cybersecurity unicorn dominating the cloud security space. We're backed by an impressive team of investors such as Capital G, ICONIQ, GGV, and SVCI, a syndicate of CISOs who invest their own money after conducting their due diligence.

 We are looking for a highly\-motivated, business\-focused, demonstrated team\-player to join us as a Customer Success Manager. **What We're Looking For:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.

* Knowledge of and experience working in the Cloud Security industry.

* Ability to manage competing priorities.

* Ability to travel 30%

title: Partnerships Manager
description:
**About Atlys** 




 Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.
 



 Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.
 



 Atlys is changing that.
 



 We’re building an AI\-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for
 **1M\+ travellers across 127 countries** 
 . But we’re still early.
 



  





**The Role** 




 Our partners \- card networks, banks, airlines, travel platforms, fintechs \- are mostly many times our size. The job is to get a decision\-maker to take the call, then build a construct that works commercially for both sides.
 



 The second part is the hard part. A visa is a low\-frequency purchase. A partnership only works if you find the moment in the partner's own customer journey where we belong, and structure the economics so they have a reason to care.
 **There's no playbook.** 




  





**The Job** 



* **Own a portfolio of live partnerships** 
 \- deepen them and grow what they generate.
* **Take 4–5 new partnerships live every month** 
 , with most partnerships going from first conversation to live in about two weeks.
* **Run longer\-term partnerships** 
 that may span months, multiple geographies, and involve product, legal and procurement teams.
* **Write cold outreach that gets a reply from someone senior.**
* **Build the commercial construct** 
 , not just the relationship.
* **Drive go\-live across product, operations and legal** 
 to ensure partnerships move from conversation to execution.
* **Own the numbers on every relationship you hold** 
 and stay accountable for the outcomes of your partnerships.



  





**The Ideal Candidate** 




 You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:
 


* Have
 **0–2 years of experience** 
 . Exceptional fresh graduates are welcome.
* **Have no degree or institution filter** 
 \- we care about what you can do, not where you studied.
* **Write exceptionally well** 
 . This is the highest\-weighted skill for this role.
* Can reason from first principles and build a deal structure when there is no precedent to follow.
* Can be the most junior person in the room and still run the conversation confidently.
* Have strong commercial judgement and can think about what creates value for both Atlys and the partner.
* Are patient, input\-driven and comfortable with outcomes that can be lumpy while the work remains consistent every day.
* Take strong ownership and are comfortable building something without a predefined playbook.
* Communicate exceptionally well and can build relationships with senior decision\-makers.



*We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.* 




  





**What you can expect** 




 Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.
 



 Here’s what you can expect:
 


* **Competitive compensation and equity** 
 so you participate in the value you help create.
* **Comprehensive health insurance** 
 covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check\-up on us.
* **A thoughtful leave policy** 
 with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* **Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office** 
 , so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* **Learning \& development credits** 
 to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* **Relocation support** 
 to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* **Great tools to do your best work** 
 , including high\-spec equipment and software.
* **An office designed for more than just work** 
 , with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.



  





 Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.
 



  





*Come build the intelligence layer for global travel*

* A Chartered Accountancy qualification or a master’s degree in finance, along with 2–6 years of experience in fund operations and/or client service roles within the financial services sector

title: AVP Premier Relationship Manager
description:
**Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.**
 If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
   

  

**Wealth and Personal Banking (WPB)** 
 is our new global business combining Retail Banking and Wealth Management; and Global Private Banking, to become one of the world’s largest global wealth managers with USD1\.4 trillion in assets. Across Asia, where wealth pools are growing faster than in any other region, HSBC’s wealth revenues grew 12% in 2019 (year\-on\-year) to USD5\.7 billion. Our dedicated colleagues serve millions of customers worldwide across the entire spectrum of private wealth, ranging from personal banking individuals and families, through to business owners, investors and ultra\-high\-net\-worth individuals. We provide products and services such as bank accounts, credit cards, personal loans and mortgages, as well as asset management, insurance, wealth management and private banking that best suit our customers’ needs.
   

  

 We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join the WPB team.
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 The PRM \& SPRM role are client facing roles. Playing a integral part of HSBC RBWM flagship offering of ‘’Premier Banking’’ To grow and nurture HSBC Premier relationships (High Networth Individual) segment of the Personal Banking customer base) and achieve business targets as laid down and in accordance with the business plan To facilitate a single point of contact for all Premier customers, anticipate needs and provide required banking/financial advisory services. The jobholder to ensure that high quality customer service is provided to customers in line with Global Premier Service Standards. The identification of opportunities for wealth reviews and delivering wealth solutions as an adviser are amongst the key activities to achieve your goals as complied with local regulatory requirement.
   

  

 All this needs to be achieved by keeping the highest standards of integrity towards the bank and clients and the regulatory requirements.
   

  

**Principal Accountabilities**
**Impact on the Business / Function**
* Maximize profit and achievement of the growth of Premier clients portfolio
* Achieve agreed financial targets by development of existing and new relationships
* Build effective relationships with clients to retain and develop sustainable relationships
* Complete regular reviews with clients to understand their current and long term needs and advise them on the products and services that help them achieve their goals
* Effective use of tools and information to drive client service delivery and performance
* Maintain a minimum standard of qualifying Premier clients within portfolio as stated by Group
* Build a high personal and corporate profile in the community in which you are based. Develop network of Group and External professional contacts with the aim of introducing new business, enhancing technical knowledge and promoting the brand
* Monitor and act on daily sales activity management information and other internal information tools, using them to coach the wider Branch team in support of business goals
* Establish and agree client contact strategies in line with Group operating models
* Fully utilize and input to Client Relationship Management data, ensuring all client information is complete and kept up to date
* Demonstrate excellent understanding of client needs, recommend appropriate products and services, and achieve closure of sales


**Customers / Stakeholders**
* Own the client relationship with HSBC
* Maintain a deep understanding and technical knowledge of relevant products and services available from Group sources and elsewhere in order to provide the best solutions for clients and maximize revenues for Global Wealth and the Group
* Maintain highest standard of excellence in client service across the team and with individual portfolio \- Ongoing analysis of client portfolios through marketing of ideas and researching clients
* Monitor client satisfaction data implementing portfolio level improvements
* Work with the broader branch, support and direct teams to ensure achievement of the business performance measures by delivering differentiated products and services to the client


**Leadership \& Teamwork**
* To work as part of an integrated branch management team to ensure, standards and are met and operating models delivered
* Proactively support others through direct and indirect actions beyond activities particular to this role
* Collaborate with the wider team to deliver the Branch Performance measures and plan to support the multi\-channel client journey
* Establish and maintain strong working relationships with colleagues in the wider businesses and others as appropriate to service client needs


**Operational Effectiveness \& Control**
* Ensuring that sales \& operations are undertaken in accordance with HSBC Bank and Credit Policy Manual appropriate lending guidelines
* Agree and manage lending facilities within any agreed Approval Authority
* Manage operational risk, by using relevant data to identify risk situations and take any appropriate action to minimize loss
* Adhere to selling process and sales quality requirements
* Comply with the applicable laws, regulations, Group and local guidelines related to Sanctions and Anti\-Money Laundering policy of HSBC while undertaking various day to day operations
* Remain alert and promptly report to the Sanctions Officer/ Line manager ( As applicable and required by the Anti Money Laundering and sanction Policy) if a customer is found to be engaging in sanction evasion activities or violations of policy or any other related procedures.
* Understand the legal responsibility to be vigilant for unusual activity and reporting of the unusual activities
* Support the Country or Regional Offices / Investigations by providing additional information when required
* Responsible for attending and successfully completing the Sanctions related assigned training in the mandated timeframe
* Understanding the consequences of failing to attend or successfully complete the training as mandated
* Requesting additional training that you deem necessary or appropriate to perform your jobs through your entity manager
* Demonstrate an understanding of Politically Exposed People acceptance, prohibition, guidelines in order to ensure that is fully compliant
* Understand the relatively high reputational risk that arises from any perceived weaknesses in controls in respect of substantial cash deposits or withdrawals activity, wire transfer, monetary instruments and pouch and mail
* To be aware and Identify high risk indicators for various products and Services offered by example Cash, insurance, credit cards products etc
* Ensure that all records are obtained in respect of customers or New to bank customer for any products and services provided by HSBC are as per the process laid down.
* Must ensure that the prescribed process is being followed while dealing with non HSBC customers request for monetary instruments and wire transfers
* Ensure Adherence to the regulatory guidelines and internal policy of HSBC, which includes pouch and mail, monetary instruments, cash services and payment transparency Line of Business Procedures
* To be aware of AML risk posed by pouch and mail, Monetary instruments, cash services and wire transfer services and should undergo the mandatory training for the same
* Necessary remediation steps needs to be undertaken in case if there is any breach or non\-adherence to the policy laid down
* Must undertake necessary due diligence to ensure that the nature of the transaction is in sync with the customer profile , else raise it to line manager for further clarification
* The staff must be aware of the scope of services of various products and services that are offered and those which are prohibited because of the guidelines laid down in the line of Business procedures and must ensure the same is communicated to customer in a effective and polite manner
* Ensure adequate due diligence is undertaken by the Individual/team to ensure that the nature of the various transactions of wire transfer, cash services, monetary instruments are in sync with customer profile


**Major Challenges**
 The bank seeks to grow business through an efficient operation and the pursuit of providing clients with globally consistent experiences, excellent service, cross selling products and services appropriate to client needs in order to enhance that value. In the face of fierce competition in this segment the bank is seeking to grow the significance of this group in their contribution to our business.
   

  

 The Premier segment typically comprises clients with Total Relationship Balances of 25lakhs or more.
   

  

 We should also recognize our responsibility to the community in which we operate and improve the bank’s profile within those communities building economic value for the bank and its shareholders.
   

  

 The range of competitors and products has established an increased financial awareness in clients, creating demand for increased experience and skill at PRM level.
   

  

**A Premier Relationship Manager Requires The Following Key Attributes**
* Excellent sales and people management skills
* Client driven with a strong focus on quality of service
* Strong interpersonal communication skills
* A strong sense of ownership, responsibility and accountability
* An excellent understanding of financial planning, wealth management and understanding client need


 The jobholder forms an integral part of the wider HSBC management team. As part of this wider team the jobholder is expected to identify opportunities in their day to day activities that directly or indirectly contribute to the success of colleagues with differing responsibilities, particularly in other areas of HSBC such as Commercial and Private Bank.
   

  

**Role Context**
 The jobholder will own and manage a portfolio of clients with Total Relationship balance of 25 lacs or more
   

  

**The Jobholder Has Prime Responsibility For**
* Maximizing growth in their portfolio and achieving the plan/metrics
* Leading Premier activities to ensure opportunities are identified and client needs are met effectively, maximizing all available resources.
* Compliance with the relevant Group standards including regulatory organization as applied to the implementation of the strategy in their country


 Jobholder will hold Lending Approval authorities appropriate to their role.
   

  

 The job holder operates within the approved operating and strategic plan process to develop the business.
   

  

**Management of Risk**
* Adheres to processes and controls to identify and mitigate risks and ensures timely escalation of control issues and reputation risks.


**Observation of Internal Controls**
* Maintains HSBC internal control standards and addresses audit points and/or any issues raised by regulators in a timely manner.


**Role Dimensions**
* Portfolio Size of Total Relationship Value of 25 lakhs or more per customer
* Portfolio Size of Premier clients or number of relationships as dictated by market requirements
* Growth in Income, balances, clients volumes, number of clients, etc..


**Qualifications \- External**
**Knowledge \& Experience**
* Bachelor's degree with relevant experience
* Minimum of 5\-8 years of Relationship management work experience with high net worth clients.
* Evidence of strong sales results in insurance and investment products
* Relationship management experience with high net worth clients
* Strong technical skills in wealth management
* Strong communication, client focus and influencing skills
* Strong sales orientation, networking and portfolio management skills
* Sound knowledge of financial services products and services and the client relationship management system
* Understanding of business banking client segment and products and services
* Local regulatory \& license requirements \- job holder should possess valid licenses with accreditation on wealth management and qualification as required by country
* Clear view on how to work with Compliance, Credit \& Risk and Internal Control to ensure a balanced risk operating environment
* Able to communicate well in English and local languages


**Accreditations**
* IRDA (Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority) and AMFI (Association of Mutual Funds) certifications are mandatory


**Leadership Capabilities**
* Have an understanding of the immediate regional Global Wealth strategy and the ability to plan own activities accordingly
* Be ambitious about providing the highest standards of delivery to colleagues and clients
* Show ability to set stretch goals for self and the ability to deliver these with courage and tenacity
* Be authentic and show ability to engage with colleagues and clients to deliver at pace
* Make considered decisions that protect HSBC \& Global Wealth values, reputation and businesses


**Technical Capabilities**
**Global Wealth Management \- Relationship Manager Technical Capabilities**
**Client Skills**
* Client focus
* Sales orientation
* Portfolio management
* Communicating \& influencing


**Business Acumen**
* Marketplace knowledge
* Business understanding


**Solutions**
* Premier products and services
* HSBC services and propositions


**Processes**
* Risk and compliance
* Business processes
* Tools and systems


**Additional Information**
* Mandatory to successfully complete Anti\-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post\-course assessment as Required
* The global career band level will be offered depending on the selected candidate's skill and relevant experience
* Familiarity with AI\-enabled tools is an advantage.


 As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision\-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.
   

  

 You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.
   

  

 HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
   

  

 Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
   

  

 Issued by The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited, India

title: Named Account Manager - North
description:
**Our Mission**

We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real\-world problems with cutting\-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
   

  

 We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real\-time problem\-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
   

  

**Job Summary**
**Your Career**
 The Named Account Manager partners with our customers to secure their entire digital experience. You’re motivated by the desire to solve critical challenges facing our customer’s secure environment, so you’re prepared to connect them with a solution for every stage of threat prevention. This role is a significant driver of company revenue and growth. As an experienced and dynamic sales professional, you’re responsible for leading and driving sales engagements.
   

  

 Palo Alto Networks is leading the charge in platformization, offering best\-in\-breed solutions that enable customers to build a truly zero\-trust security architecture and navigate critical transformations. To ensure our sales team is equipped to guide customers, we've developed FLIGHT, an immersive onboarding program. Flight blends virtual and in\-person learning at our headquarters, where new sales hires will participate in dynamic cohorts, fully dedicated to their training without customer distractions. This focused approach ensures they emerge as well\-prepared sales professionals, ready to help customers leverage our comprehensive portfolio.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 Serve as the go\-to trusted advisor in Identity Security, influencing strategy and deal execution across complex enterprise opportunities.
   

  

* Partner with product, SE, and technical specialists to shape and deliver customer strategies \- driving adoption, modernisation and expansion of PANW Idira solutions.
* Translate complex Identity Security concepts into clear, business\-driven outcomes for executives, demonstrating technical relevance leveraging insights to influence CxO\-level decisions.
* Influence cross\-portfolio demand by identifying and articulating Identity Security needs across large complex portfolios.
* Stay on top of cybersecurity trends, competitor movements, and customer challenges to position PANW as a strategic partner.
* Your consultative selling experience will identify business challenges and create solutions for prospects and our customers
* Understand the competitive landscape and customer needs so you can effectively position the portfolio of Palo Alto Networks solutions
* Create clear goals and complete accurate forecasting through developing a detailed territory plan
* Leverage prospect stories to create a compelling value proposition with insights into value for that specific account
* Travel as necessary within your territory, and to company\-wide


**Qualifications**
****Your Experience****
* 10\+ years sales experience in Territory sales with a wide\-ranged network in Enterprise accounts in North India region
* Proven to consistently achieve sales goals and experience with closing larger deals
* Experience in direct customer selling role managing north region as terriorty
* Proven track record of successfully closing complex enterprise deals in cybersecurity or enterprise SaaS.
* Demonstrated ability to grow new logos and expand within existing customers.
* Outcome\-oriented with strong commercial judgment.
* Technical aptitude for understanding how technology products and solutions solve business problems
* Identifies problems, reviews data, determines the root causes, and provides scalable solutions
* Cultivate relationships with our channel partners to bring channel\-centric go\-to\-market approach for our customers
* Demonstrates in depth knowledge of the full sales cycle and the ability to follow a structured sales process
* Commercial curiosity and the ability to uncover customer pain points through active listening.
* Ability to take a holistic approach to problem solving by understanding the bigger picture, and considering complex interrelationships and outcomes
* Excellent time management skills, and work with high levels of autonomy and self\-direction


**Our Commitment**
 We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
   

  

 We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.
   

  

 Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

 The Position
   

  

**Patient Journey Partner\- Hematology**

**The Position**
 A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.
   

  

 We are seeking candidates to join our team as Patient Journey Partner In this role, you will have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on patient care by connecting Roche’s capabilities and resources to co\-create solutions with key stakeholders involved in the patient journey. Your role is multifaceted, addressing diverse patient journey needs such as accelerating access to treatments, streamlining decision making. This role is locally embedded in the ecosystem, it is an integrated role, functionally agnostic, (i.e. it does not fit into the traditional concepts of Commercial/Sales or Medical Affairs). The PJP focuses on the importance of bringing the outside in, working with partners to uncover all potential opportunities to transform outcomes for patients, faster. They also bring the inside out, to bring Roche expertise, science and knowledge to the ecosystem.
   

  

**Your Opportunity**

You will be creating and executing strategies for the top public \& private accounts, aligning with and support state teams for effective execution of the state strategies, so as to serve and maximize patients with Roche Innovations

* You will be leading collaboration in field through co\-creation of solutions for key accounts


**Who You Are**
* You are someone who has a relevant graduate/ post graduate degree in Science. From an experience standpoint having more than 8 years’ experience with 4\+ years in Oncology or Hematology
* You must exhibit strong collaboration and networking skills, process orientation and alliance management


 Who we are
   

  

 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life\-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
   

  

 Let’s build a healthier future, together.
   

  

**Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

 We are seeking candidates to join our team as Patient Journey Partner In this role, you will have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on patient care by connecting Roche’s capabilities and resources to co\-create solutions with key stakeholders involved in the patient journey. Your role is multifaceted, addressing diverse patient journey needs such as accelerating access to treatments, streamlining decision making. This role is locally embedded in the ecosystem, it is an integrated role, functionally agnostic, (i.e. it does not fit into the traditional concepts of Commercial/Sales or Medical Affairs). The PJP focuses on the importance of bringing the outside in, working with partners to uncover all potential opportunities to transform outcomes for patients, faster. They also bring the inside out, to bring Roche expertise, science and knowledge to the ecosystem.
   

  

**Your Opportunity**
* You will be responsible for end to end management of Top Therapy Area Expert relations and legitimate needs through right identification of challenges, belief, motivators
* You will be a one point of contact for top accounts of the state. You will be creating and executing strategies for the top public \& private accounts, aligning with and support state teams for effective execution of the state strategies, so as to serve and maximize patients with Roche Innovations
* You will be building relationship with key decision makers in the account Identifying and resolving business issues in top accounts and Implement strategies and drive results for enhancing access to Roche innovations
* You will be leading collaboration in field through co\-creation of solutions for key accounts


**Who You Are**
* You are someone who has a relevant graduate/ post graduate degree in Science. From an experience standpoint having more than 8 years’ experience with 4\+ years in Ophthalmology
* You must exhibit strong collaboration and networking skills, process orientation and alliance management


 Who we are
   

  

 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life\-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
   

  

 Let’s build a healthier future, together.
   

  

**Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

title: Marketplace Vendor Growth Manager
description:
**About the job** 




**Position:** 
 Marketplace \& Vendor Growth Manager
 



**Department:** 
 Marketplace / Business Growth
 



**Experience:** 
 2–6 years
 



**Location:** 
 Netaji Subhash Place, Pitampura, Delhi
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



  





**About Nutristar** 




 Nutristar is a growing Health \& Wellness marketplace focused on bringing trusted brands and products across nutrition, supplements, fitness, wellness and healthy living to consumers through a strong digital\-first platform.
 



 We are looking for a
 **smart, driven and highly commercially oriented Marketplace \& Vendor Growth Manager** 
 who can take ownership of building and scaling Nutristar’s brand/vendor ecosystem.
 



 This is not a routine vendor\-management role. We are looking for someone who can
 **identify opportunities, onboard the right brands, negotiate commercially, analyse data and continuously find ways to grow marketplace GMV, revenue and profitability.** 




 Key Responsibilities
 



**Brand \& Vendor Acquisition** 




 ·       Identify and build a pipeline of high\-potential health, wellness, nutrition and lifestyle brands.
 



 ·       Reach out to brands, pitch Nutristar and drive the complete onboarding process.
 



 ·       Build strong relationships with founders, business heads and brand teams.
 



 ·       Negotiate commercials, margins, commissions, payment terms, exclusivity and promotional participation.
 



 ·       Continuously expand the marketplace with relevant, differentiated and high\-potential brands.
 



**Marketplace Growth** 




 ·       Own marketplace GMV, revenue, assortment and brand growth.
 



 ·       Identify categories, brands and products with high growth potential.
 



 ·       Analyse sales, conversion, margins, AOV, repeat purchases, inventory and product performance.
 



 ·       Develop strategies to increase sales of existing brands and improve overall marketplace productivity.
 



 ·       Identify gaps in assortment and proactively bring in products/brands to fill them.
 



**Business \& Analytics** 




 ·       Strongly data\-driven decision making — numbers should be a core part of the role.
 



 ·       Track marketplace KPIs and create actionable insights from data.
 



 ·       Analyse brand\-wise, category\-wise and SKU\-wise performance.
 



 ·       Identify underperforming vendors/products and develop corrective action plans.
 



 ·       Evaluate commercial viability and ROI of new brands and partnerships.
 



 ·       Prepare regular marketplace performance reports and growth plans.
 



**Merchandising \& Commercials** 




 ·       Work closely with the marketing and e\-commerce teams on promotions, campaigns and merchandising.
 



 ·       Ensure the right products and brands receive the right visibility.
 



 ·       Drive vendor participation in Nutristar campaigns and promotional events.
 



 ·       Optimise assortment, pricing, offers and product visibility to maximise marketplace performance.
 



 ·       Work towards improving marketplace margins and contribution.
 



**Cross\-functional Ownership** 




 ·       Coordinate with operations, finance, marketing, customer support and technology teams for smooth vendor operations.
 



 ·       Ensure brands are onboarded quickly and efficiently.
 



 ·       Resolve commercial, operational and performance\-related issues with vendors.
 



 ·       Continuously improve marketplace processes and vendor experience.
 



 What We’re Looking For
 



 ·       
 **2–6 years of experience** 
 in marketplace, e\-commerce, category management, business development, key accounts, vendor management or a similar commercial role.
 



 ·       Experience with marketplaces/e\-commerce is strongly preferred.
 



 ·       Experience in
 **health, wellness, nutrition, beauty, FMCG or D2C** 
 would be an advantage.
 



 ·       Strong analytical and Excel/Google Sheets skills.
 



 ·       Excellent understanding of
 **GMV, revenue, margins, contribution, conversion, AOV, sell\-through and marketplace metrics.** 




 ·       Strong negotiation and communication skills.
 



 ·       High business acumen — able to understand
 **what will actually make money** 
 , not just execute tasks.
 



 ·       Extremely proactive, fast\-moving and comfortable working independently.
 



 ·       Ability to look at numbers, identify a problem/opportunity and
 **take action without being spoon\-fed.** 




 ·       Strong ownership mentality and willingness to work in a fast\-growing environment.
 



 ·       Excellent presentation and relationship\-building skills.
 



 The Ideal Candidate
 



 We are looking for someone who is:
 



**Smart \| Fast \| Analytical \| Commercially Sharp \| Entrepreneurial \| Proactive \| Excellent Communicator** 




 Someone who doesn't just say
 *“the numbers are down”* 
 — but asks
 **why, figures it out, proposes a solution and gets it implemented.** 




**Preferred:** 
 Female candidates with strong communication, commercial maturity and a high\-energy, entrepreneurial approach are encouraged to apply.
 



 What You’ll Get
 



 ·       Significant ownership of Nutristar’s marketplace growth.
 



 ·       Direct exposure to brands, founders and business leaders.
 



 ·       Opportunity to build and shape the marketplace from an early/growth stage.
 



 ·       High degree of autonomy and responsibility.
 



 ·       Fast\-paced, entrepreneurial working environment.
 



 ·       Performance\-driven growth opportunities.

title: Head – School Partnerships & Growth
description:
HEAD – SALES
   

  

**Department:** 
 Sales \& Business Development
   

  

**Location:** 
 Delhi NCR / Pan India
   

  

**Reports To:** 
 CEO / Business Leadership
   

  

**About EdTerra**
 EdTerra Edventures is a leading experiential learning and educational travel company that designs and delivers immersive learning journeys for school students across India and international destinations.
   

  

 We partner with schools to create meaningful experiences that combine travel, learning, culture, adventure and real\-world exposure.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for a
 **Head – Sales** 
 to lead EdTerra's sales function and drive the next phase of revenue growth.
   

  

 This is a
 **business leadership role** 
 with end\-to\-end ownership of the sales engine—from market strategy and school acquisition to key account growth, sales\-team performance, forecasting and revenue delivery.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will be a commercially strong, data\-driven and inspiring sales leader who can build scalable sales systems while personally driving strategic relationships with large schools and institutional partners.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities1\. Revenue \& Business Growth
   

  

* Own the overall sales revenue, growth and commercial performance for the business.
* Develop and execute the annual and quarterly sales strategy in line with organizational objectives.
* Translate business targets into territory, segment, product and team\-level targets.
* Identify new revenue opportunities across geographies, school segments and products.
* Drive both new business acquisition and growth of existing accounts.
* Develop strategies to increase customer lifetime value, repeat business and wallet share.
* School \& Institutional Partnerships
* Build and maintain strong relationships with school management, principals, trustees, coordinators and other key decision\-makers.
* Lead negotiations and closures for strategic/high\-value school accounts.
* Develop long\-term partnerships with schools and educational institutions.
* Create account\-development plans for key schools.
* Drive cross\-selling and up\-selling across EdTerra's domestic, international and experiential learning programmes.
* Act as the senior escalation point for strategic clients.
* Sales Team Leadership
* Lead and mentor the complete sales organization across regions/functions.
* Define team structures, roles, territories, targets and performance expectations.
* Recruit, coach and develop high\-performing sales managers and sales professionals.
* Establish a strong culture of ownership, accountability and performance.
* Conduct structured weekly, monthly and quarterly business reviews.
* Identify capability gaps and implement targeted coaching and development plans.
* Build a strong succession pipeline for critical sales positions.
* Sales Process \& Performance Management
* Build a predictable and scalable sales process from lead generation → qualification → meetings → proposals → negotiation → closure → repeat business.
* Establish clear sales KPIs and performance dashboards.
* Monitor conversion ratios at every stage of the funnel.
* Improve sales productivity and reduce sales\-cycle time.
* Ensure disciplined CRM usage and accurate pipeline management.
* Establish mechanisms for identifying and resolving pipeline bottlenecks.
* Forecasting \& Business Intelligence
* Own the monthly and quarterly sales forecast.
* Maintain strong visibility on pipeline value, probability and expected closures.
* Develop accurate revenue projections based on historical performance and current pipeline.
* Use sales data to identify trends, risks and opportunities.
* Present actionable sales insights and recommendations to the leadership team.
* Develop territory\-wise and account\-wise performance dashboards.
* Market Expansion
* Identify and evaluate new cities, regions and school segments for expansion.
* Analyse competitor positioning, pricing, offerings and market trends.
* Develop go\-to\-market strategies for new products and markets.
* Identify emerging opportunities within the education and experiential\-learning ecosystem.
* Work with the leadership team to evaluate strategic partnerships and new business channels.
* Key Account Growth \& Retention
* Build a structured Key Account Management framework.
* Develop annual growth plans for strategic schools.
* Drive repeat journeys, renewals and increased engagement with existing schools.
* Monitor account health, satisfaction and revenue potential.
* Ensure high\-value clients receive proactive relationship management.
* Work with Operations and Customer Experience teams to resolve critical client concerns.
* Commercial \& Margin Ownership
* Balance revenue growth with profitability and contribution margins.
* Participate in pricing and commercial strategy.
* Establish appropriate discounting and negotiation frameworks.
* Monitor deal economics and commercial effectiveness.
* Work closely with Finance to improve collection efficiency and reduce outstanding receivables.
* Ensure sales commitments remain commercially and operationally viable.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration


**Work Closely With**
* Marketing – lead generation, campaigns and brand positioning
* Product – product development, pricing and market fit
* Operations – delivery feasibility and execution
* Finance – pricing, margins, collections and commercial controls
* HR – manpower planning, hiring and capability development
* Customer Experience – client satisfaction and retention


 Ensure seamless alignment between
 **what is sold, what is promised and what is delivered** 
 .
   

  

 Success in the First 12 Months
   

  

**The Successful Candidate Will Be Expected To**
* Deliver agreed annual revenue and growth targets.
* Build a predictable and healthy sales pipeline.
* Improve sales conversion and sales productivity.
* Strengthen the key\-school account portfolio.
* Increase repeat business and customer retention.
* Build a high\-performing and accountable sales leadership team.
* Improve forecast accuracy.
* Establish standardized sales processes and performance dashboards.
* Identify and successfully penetrate new markets.
* Improve revenue quality and contribution margins.


 Key Performance Indicators
   

  

**Business**
* Revenue Achievement %
* YoY Revenue Growth
* Gross Contribution / Margin
* New Revenue


**Acquisition**
* New Schools Acquired
* New Revenue from New Accounts
* Conversion Rate
* Average Deal Value


**Retention \& Growth**
* Repeat Revenue %
* School Retention
* Key Account Growth
* Revenue per Strategic Account


**Sales Productivity**
* Pipeline Coverage
* Sales Cycle
* Lead\-to\-Meeting Conversion
* Meeting\-to\-Closure Conversion
* Individual \& Team Productivity


**Forecasting**
* Forecast Accuracy
* Pipeline Health
* Closure Predictability


**People**
* Team Target Achievement
* Sales Attrition
* Manager Productivity
* Internal Talent Development


 Candidate ProfileExperience
   

  

* 10–15\+ years of progressive experience in B2B / institutional / consultative sales.
* 4\+ years in a senior sales leadership role managing sizeable sales teams.
* Proven experience owning significant revenue targets.
* Experience managing multi\-city or multi\-region sales operations preferred.
* Strong experience in relationship\-led businesses such as education, EdTech, travel, hospitality, SaaS, media or other B2B services will be advantageous.


 Education
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in any relevant discipline.
* MBA/PGDM in Sales, Marketing, Business Management or a related field preferred.


 Core Competencies
   

  

* Strategic Sales Leadership
* Revenue \& P\&L Orientation
* B2B / Institutional Sales
* Enterprise/Key Account Management
* Negotiation \& Commercial Acumen
* Sales Forecasting
* CRM \& Sales Analytics
* Market Expansion
* Team Building \& Leadership
* Coaching \& Performance Management
* Cross\-functional Collaboration
* Executive Communication


 Leadership Traits We Value
   

  

**We Are Looking For Someone Who**
* Thinks like a business owner, not just a salesperson.
* Is highly accountable for outcomes.
* Can operate strategically while remaining close to the ground.
* Uses data to make decisions.
* Builds strong, long\-term relationships.
* Can challenge existing processes and create better systems.
* Develops people rather than simply managing them.
* Is comfortable working in a fast\-paced, growth\-oriented environment.
* Has the energy and maturity to represent EdTerra with senior school stakeholders.


 Why Join EdTerra?
   

  

 At EdTerra, sales is not simply about selling a product.
   

  

 It is about building long\-term partnerships with schools and helping create experiences that can have a lasting impact on students.
   

  

 As Head – Sales, you will have the opportunity to
 **shape the sales organization, influence business strategy, build a high\-performing team and directly contribute to EdTerra's next phase of growth.**
 Skills: leadership,sales,management

title: Ecommerce Manager
description:
**Job Title: E\-Commerce \& Marketplace Growth Manager** 




  





 We are looking for a highly driven and commercially minded
 **E\-Commerce \& Marketplace Growth Manager** 
 to take ownership of our online sales channels and drive growth across marketplaces, our website, and other digital commerce platforms.
 



  





 This is not a purely operational role. We are looking for someone who can think like a business owner—someone who can identify opportunities, improve sales, optimise profitability, study competitors, develop new product ideas, and build new revenue channels.
 



  





 The ideal candidate will manage and grow our presence across platforms such as
 **Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, our own website, and other relevant marketplaces and aggregator portals** 
 .
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Marketplace Management \& Growth** 



* Manage and grow sales across Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra and other relevant e\-commerce and aggregator platforms.
* Create, optimise and manage product listings, including titles, descriptions, keywords, images and product information.
* Monitor product performance and identify opportunities to improve sales and visibility.
* Plan and execute pricing, discounts, offers, bundles and promotional campaigns.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure inventory availability and minimise stock\-outs.
* Monitor product ratings, reviews, returns and customer feedback.
* Identify underperforming SKUs and develop strategies to improve or discontinue them.
* Identify high\-performing products and opportunities to scale them.



  





**2\. Website Sales \& Digital Commerce Growth** 



* Drive sales and growth through the company website.
* Identify opportunities to improve website conversion rates and customer experience.
* Create product bundles, combo offers, trial packs, family packs, premium packs and other initiatives to increase average order value.
* Develop cross\-selling and upselling opportunities across the product portfolio.
* Work with internal and external teams to improve product pages, offers and customer journeys.
* Develop strategies to increase repeat purchases and customer retention.



  





**3\. Customer Feedback, Testimonials \& Retention** 



* Develop and manage a structured process for collecting customer feedback.
* Conduct customer calls to understand product experience and satisfaction.
* Identify satisfied customers and collect written and video testimonials.
* Build a strong repository of customer reviews, testimonials and user\-generated content for use across digital platforms.
* Follow up with customers to encourage repeat purchases and referrals.
* Analyse customer complaints and feedback to identify opportunities for product and service improvement.



  





**4\. Competitor Research \& Pricing Strategy** 



* Continuously monitor competitors, their products, pricing, offers and promotions.
* Conduct regular market research to identify trending products and emerging opportunities.
* Identify products that competitors are selling successfully and evaluate whether they can be developed, manufactured or sourced in\-house.
* Work with internal teams to identify opportunities for competitive pricing while maintaining healthy margins.
* Prepare regular competitor and market intelligence reports for management.



  





**5\. New Product \& Revenue Opportunities** 



* Identify new product categories and opportunities that can generate additional revenue.
* Research products currently performing well in the market and assess their commercial potential.
* Identify opportunities to manufacture, source or develop products at competitive pricing.
* Work with internal teams to develop new SKUs, variants, sizes, bundles and product extensions.
* Explore high\-margin complementary products and add\-on opportunities.
* Present commercially viable new product and revenue ideas to management on a regular basis.



  





**6\. New Digital Sales Channels** 



* Identify and onboard relevant e\-commerce platforms, aggregator portals and other digital sales channels.
* Explore opportunities for affiliate marketing, referral programs and micro\-influencer partnerships.
* Develop strategies to increase direct\-to\-consumer sales and reduce dependency on any single marketplace.
* Identify potential opportunities in bulk orders, corporate sales, gifting and B2B partnerships where relevant.



  





**7\. Sales, Data \& Profitability** 



* Track daily, weekly and monthly sales performance across all channels.
* Monitor profitability at a product and channel level.
* Analyse the impact of discounts, commissions, returns and promotional campaigns on margins.
* Identify opportunities to reduce costs and improve profitability.
* Prepare regular MIS and growth reports for management.
* Take ownership of assigned revenue and growth targets.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 



* Proven experience in managing e\-commerce marketplaces such as Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra or similar platforms.
* Strong understanding of online product listings, pricing, promotions and marketplace operations.
* Commercial mindset with the ability to identify new sales and revenue opportunities.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to understand product profitability, margins and pricing.
* Experience with website sales and D2C e\-commerce will be an advantage.
* Comfortable speaking with customers and conducting feedback or testimonial calls.
* Ability to conduct competitor and market research.
* Highly proactive, organised and result\-oriented.
* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of business outcomes.



  





**Preferred Profile** 




 We would prefer someone who:
 


* Has hands\-on experience managing multiple e\-commerce platforms.
* Understands both
 **sales growth and profitability** 
 .
* Can independently identify problems and propose solutions.
* Is comfortable working in a fast\-paced and entrepreneurial environment.
* Has a strong interest in consumer products, digital commerce and new product development.
* Thinks beyond day\-to\-day operations and actively looks for new business opportunities.

**Consulting –** 
**Manager\- Customer Service Transformation and AI**
**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 The
 **Manager – Customer Service Transformation and AI** 
 will drive AI\-led service transformation initiatives within the Customer practice, combining service strategy, AI solution design, process improvement, and delivery excellence. The role will support clients in reimagining service journeys, contact centre operations, field service, and knowledge\-enabled support models through responsible use of AI, automation, analytics, and workflow orchestration. You will work with senior stakeholders to identify transformation opportunities, shape practical roadmaps, and deliver measurable improvements in customer experience, service productivity, resolution quality, and operating efficiency.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Business Development \& Market Leadership**
* Support the development of AI\-led service transformation opportunities across advisory and implementation engagements, contributing to pipeline growth and client relationship expansion.
* Contribute to proposals, RFP responses, solution narratives, and executive presentations focused on service modernization, AI adoption, and customer operations improvement.
* Support GTM development for AI\-enabled service offerings across sectors, including contact center transformation, intelligent case management, field service optimization, and digital self\-service.
* Develop reusable assets, accelerators, and points of view on AI\-led service transformation, customer operations, and service experience modernization.
* Stay current on emerging service models, AI adoption patterns, automation trends, and customer expectations that may influence client service transformation priorities.


**Client Engagement \& Delivery**
* Lead workstreams within service transformation programs from current\-state assessment through roadmap design, implementation planning, and adoption support.
* Assess service processes, customer journeys, operating models, channel mix, agent workflows, knowledge management practices, and performance metrics to identify improvement opportunities.
* Design AI\-enabled service operating models, service blueprints, automation use cases, governance structures, and adoption roadmaps aligned to client business outcomes.
* Support implementation of AI use cases such as virtual agents, agent assist, intelligent routing, case summarization, sentiment insights, knowledge search, predictive service, and workflow automation.
* Partner with technology, data, and business teams to translate service pain points into business requirements, solution concepts, process maps, and delivery\-ready backlogs.
* Develop business cases and benefits models to quantify productivity gains, containment improvement, average handle time reduction, service quality improvement, and cost\-to\-serve impact.
* Ensure delivery quality across assigned workstreams, including scope management, stakeholder coordination, milestone tracking, issue resolution, and executive reporting.

title: Area Manager - Coronary Vascular

 Coronary Vascular is focused on advancing therapies that support the treatment of coronary artery disease, hypertension, and related cardiovascular conditions. The team partners closely with interventional cardiologists, catheterisation laboratory teams, and healthcare institutions to expand access to coronary vascular technologies and drive clinical adoption across diverse care settings.
   

  

 This position supports the Delhi NCR, Muradabad, and Muzaffarnagar territory and is based in Gurugram. The role operates in a remote field\-based sales model with regular customer visits across the assigned geography. Approximately 30% travel is required to support customer engagement, clinical case coverage, training activities, distributor management, and business development initiatives.
   

  

 As an Area Manager, you will be responsible for driving territory growth, expanding customer adoption of Coronary Vascular products, and supporting clinicians in the effective use of cardiovascular technologies. This role requires a combination of commercial acumen, clinical knowledge, and account management capabilities to achieve business objectives while strengthening customer relationships across the assigned territory.

* Build and maintain relationships with key opinion leaders, interventional cardiologists, and clinical teams to support product adoption and long\-term account growth.
* Provide procedural support and clinical expertise during coronary interventions and other relevant cardiovascular procedures.
* Partner with distributors and channel partners to maintain product availability, optimise secondary sales, and support commercial growth initiatives.
* Analyse market dynamics, customer needs, and competitive activity to identify growth opportunities and support business planning.
* Deliver product education, post\-sales training, and customer support programmes to enhance clinical confidence and adoption.
* Maintain accurate sales forecasts, customer records, and business reports to support territory management and operational effectiveness.

* OR Associate’s Degree AND 6\+ years experience\*
* OR Bachelor’s Degree AND 4\+ years experience\*

* Experience managing multi\-level stakeholder relationships across hospitals, healthcare systems, and clinical departments.
* Clinical experience within an interventional suite, hospital environment, emergency medical services, or procedural care setting.
* Experience delivering clinician training, product education, or post\-sales support programmes.
* Knowledge of coronary vascular technologies and cardiovascular disease treatment pathways.

 Specialist – Regional Customer Success Operations, Services

 Services within Mastercard is responsible for acquiring, engaging, and retaining customers by managing fraud and risk, enhancing cybersecurity, and improving the digital payments experience. We provide value\-added services and leverage expertise, data\-driven insights, and execution.

As advocates for customer experience, this team is accountable for a strong onboarding experience, providing ongoing strategic support, and fostering long\-term relationships.
   

  

 They work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams to address customer needs, gather feedback on product improvements, develop tailored strategies that enhance customer satisfaction and retention, build customer advocacy to support our B2B marketing campaigns and create leads for value expansion for our Business Development teams. By focusing on proactive engagement and personalized service with our customers, the team is dedicated to driving customer value and contributing to the overall growth of the organization.

 Are you passionate about building scalable operations that empower customer\-facing teams to deliver exceptional value? Join Mastercard’s Services Customer Success team as a Customer Success Operations Sr. Specialist.  The Sr. Specialist of Services Global Customer Success Operations reports to the Customer Success Lead within the APAC and will support in the development and delivery of strategic priorities for Customer Success within Mastercard Services. The primary focus of the role will be to support best\-in\-class Customer Success Operations Mastercard Services’ business.  Strategy \& Process Design

 Systems \& Tools

 Metrics \& Insights
   

  

* Track KPIs to measure CS performance and customer health
* Build dashboards and reports for stakeholders ranging from executives to front\-line teams
* Track leading indicators of positive outcomes and perform analysis to identify trends that enable action


 Collaboration \& Enablement
   

  

* Work with Product, Value Enablement, and Program teams to embed CS metrics into broader business KPIs
* Champion CS best practices across the organization and support change management initiatives
* Conduct research on emerging trends (e.g., AI in CS) to inform strategy and innovation


**All About You**
* Customer Success Operations or related role experience with an understanding of CS strategy and execution
* Proven ability to design scalable processes and translate technical capabilities into business value
* Strong verbal and written communication skills to effectively convey the vision, goals, and progress of customer success initiatives
* Ability to work globally and cross\-functionally; persuasive through influence with stakeholders to gain buy\-in for customer success strategies
* Strong analytical skills with experience in reporting, dashboards, and performance metrics to drive customer success outcomes
* Experience integrating with other technology solutions in the customer success space (e.g. Gainsight, Salesforce, Tableau, etc.) to create seamless and easy\-to\-use processes
* Takes a high degree of ownership, optimizing processes to enhance efficiency and fostering a culture of excellence and continuous improvement
* Experience in managing organizational changes, training colleagues, and ensuring adoption of new processes and technologies including AI
* Passionate about delivering for our customers; always exhibits \& champions a customer\-centric mentality
* Experience with Gainsight or similar CS platforms, a plus


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

 We're looking for an ownership\-driven customer success manager who can run the back bone of customer experience for Oyela. You'll be the single point of accountability and own Oyela's entire post\-purchase customer experience — the team, the process and the promise. You will lead 10 support agents and 2–4 escalation leads, and be the single owner of what a customer hears from us, how fast they hear it, and what happens inside the company when they raise an issue. This is a build role, not a queue\-monitoring role.
 



 This is a frontend driven customer first approach role instead of operational lead.

* **Team \& KRAs:** 
 Define KRAs and scorecards for agents and escalation leads. Run weekly QA audits, coaching, 1:1s, rosters, training, hiring and retention.

 Own the helpdesk stack across WhatsApp, calls, email, Instagram, chat and marketplaces. Define contact\-reason taxonomy, P1–P4 priority, routing, SLAs, reply templates and brand tone — and define exactly what "closed" means, with CSAT on every closure.

 Write an SOP for every contact reason and every internal trigger, with a time standard on every step. Maintain them versioned, review monthly/quarterly, update on any policy or partner change, and audit adherence.

 Own the leadership dashboard (FRT, resolution TAT, SLA adherence, backlog, CSAT, contacts per order, cost per contact). Run a weekly Voice\-of\-Customer review with ops and product to fix root causes — and bring support volume down, not just response time.

* Competitive compensation with performance\-based growth.
